Update: Verified the latest Noob Tower Defense Codes on August 10, 2026

Noob Tower Defense codes are worth grabbing before you burn all your coins and gems on rolls. Better towers and upgrades matter fast in this game, and a few free rewards can make the early waves feel less stingy.

Public code lists disagree after Season 2, so start with the newest codes below before testing older ones.

All working Noob Tower Defense codes

  • ENCHANTOVERHAUL: 450 Gems & 750 Coins (NEW)
  • IMPOSSIBLE: 450 Gems & 750 Coins
  • ECONOMY: 500 Gems
  • BANANAS: 500 Gems
  • RAIDS: 500 Gems
  • TradePlaza: 450 Coins & 150 Gems
  • Summer: 350 Coins & 125 Gems
  • Index: 500 Coins & 150 Gems
  • ENDLESS: 300 Gems
  • UPD3: 300 Coins
  • NTDSPRING: 300 Gems
  • LIKES18K: 400 Gems
  • hallsecret: 200 Coins
  • UPD2: 300 Gems

Redeem ENDLESSDELAY, UPD4, and Season2 First, if you are short on time. Older codes like UPD3 and LIKES18K are where public lists disagree most, so treat them as quick bonus tries if they still work on your server.

Expired Noob Tower Defense codes

1000LIKES, 100KVISITS, 100LIKES, 500LIKES, LIKES2K, LIKES500, LIKES5K, LIKES6K, LIKES7K, REWRITE, SHIFTLOCK

How to redeem Noob Tower Defense codes

The code box sits inside the Settings menu. If you do not see it yet, finish the tutorial first.

  1. Open Noob Tower Defense on Roblox.
  2. Complete the tutorial if you are playing for the first time.
  3. Click the gear icon on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter a working code in the code box.
  5. Press Redeem to claim your reward.

If a newly added code fails, rejoin the game or try a private server before crossing it off. Roblox code changes can take a little while to reach every public server.

Why your Noob Tower Defense code is not working

Most failed codes come from old servers, expired rewards, or tiny typing mistakes.

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed the wrong capitalization or added an extra space.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You have not finished the tutorial.
  • You are on an older server that has not received the latest code update.
  • Roblox or the Noob Tower Defense server is having a temporary issue.

For mixed-case codes like Season2, copy and paste instead of typing manually. It is the easiest way to avoid wasting a valid reward.

Where to find more Noob Tower Defense codes

Noob Tower Defense codes usually appear around Saturday updates, like milestones, delays, and new game modes. These are the best places to check when you want new rewards early:

  • Noob Tower Defense Roblox page
  • Noob Tower Defense Discord server
  • Vitan Games Roblox group

Discord is useful if you want codes the moment they drop, but it is also where older posts can get buried fast. You can bookmark this page if you prefer a cleaner list without testing every stale milestone code yourself.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Iron Soul Dungeon codes, Catch and Tame codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Noob Tower Defense?

Noob Tower Defense is a Roblox tower defense game by Vitan Games where you build towers, roll for rare units, upgrade favorites with enchantments, and hold off waves of blocky enemies.

Codes help most when you are still building your first reliable roster. Free gems and coins will not replace good placement, but they can give you more rolls and upgrades before the noob rush starts getting rude.

title.rendered: This YouTube Music feature turns song lyrics into shareable social posts

content.rendered:
Music streaming apps have spent years competing on audio quality, recommendations, playlists, and discovery features. But one of my favorite YouTube Music features lately has nothing to do with finding new songs. Instead, it’s the ability to turn song lyrics into social-media-ready images.

I first came across the feature while checking the lyrics of a song on YouTube Music. After selecting a few lines and tapping Share, the app generated a lyric card containing the selected lyrics, album artwork, song title, and artist name.

It may sound like a small addition, but it changes how you interact with music in a surprisingly meaningful way. Here’s everything you need to know.

What is YouTube Music’s lyrics-sharing feature?

YouTube Music’s lyrics-sharing feature allows listeners to highlight specific lines from a song and instantly turn them into lyric cards. Each card includes the selected lyrics alongside the album artwork, song title, and artist name, creating a dedicated image that can be saved or shared across social platforms.

Rather than sharing an entire song, the feature lets you spotlight the exact lyric that resonates with you.

Why lyric cards are better than screenshots

Anyone who has shared song lyrics using a screenshot has probably encountered the same issue. While the lyric may be the focus, the image usually includes playback controls, progress bars, navigation buttons, and other parts of the app interface.

Lyric cards solve that problem entirely.

Instead of capturing the whole screen, YouTube Music generates a clean image that focuses only on the selected lyrics. The song title, artist name, and album artwork remain attached to the card, giving viewers the necessary context without clutter.

The result feels more like content designed for sharing than a quick screenshot taken from a music app.

Sharing specific lyrics instead of entire songs

There are plenty of moments when a single lyric stands out more than the song itself. A lyric card allows you to share that exact line without asking someone to open a track and search for it.

The selected lyric remains the focal point, while the song title, artist name, and album artwork provide context around it. It creates a different experience from sharing a music link, where the entire song becomes the message.

Sometimes, a few words are all you want to share.

Gemini backgrounds add another layer of customization

One of the newer additions to YouTube Music’s lyric cards is support for Gemini-generated backgrounds.

While creating a lyric card, users can generate custom artwork behind the selected lyrics instead of choosing from YouTube Music’s built-in styles. Multiple background variations can be created from the same lyric selection, making it easy to experiment with different designs before sharing.

The lyrics, album artwork, song title, and artist name remain part of the card, while the AI-generated artwork appears in the background.

How to share song lyrics in YouTube Music

Sharing lyrics in YouTube Music takes only a few taps:

  1. Open YouTube Music and play the song whose lyrics you want to share.
  2. Tap the Lyrics tab.
  3. To share a single line, tap the line and select Share.
  4. To share multiple lines, long-press a lyric, select the additional lines you want, and tap Share.
  5. YouTube Music will generate a lyric card featuring the selected lyrics along with the song title, artist name, and album artwork.
  6. Choose one of the available background styles. If the feature is available on your account, you can also tap Create with AI to generate a Gemini-powered background.
  7. Tap Share.
  8. Save the lyric card to your device or share it directly to another app.

Note: During my testing, the Gemini-powered background option was not available on my YouTube Music account. Google has already introduced the feature, but the rollout appears to be limited for now. If you don’t see the Create with AI option, it may not have reached your account yet.

Related: YouTube Premium adds new podcast features, but iPhone users have to wait

A cleaner way to share song lyrics

After spending some time with the feature, it’s easy to see why YouTube Music added it. Sharing lyrics is already a major part of how people talk about music online, and lyric cards offer a far cleaner and more polished experience than traditional screenshots.

The addition of Gemini-generated backgrounds provides extra customization options, but the ability to select and share specific lyrics remains the feature’s biggest strength.

If you regularly share music on social media, this is one YouTube Music feature worth trying.

What’s your favorite way to share song lyrics online? Let us know in the comments.

  • These Gemini tricks help me finish long YouTube videos much faster
  • Tired of YouTube Shorts? Here’s how to turn them off on your phone

Update: Verified the latest Iron Soul Dungeon Codes on August 10, 2026

Iron Soul Dungeon codes are especially useful early because Race Rerolls and Cave Tickets can save you from some of the slower build grind. The public code lists for this game do not fully agree, so start with the working list below before testing older weekend and milestone rewards.

Below are the Iron Soul Dungeon codes worth trying first, the expired codes to skip, and the quick redeem steps in Roblox.

All working Iron Soul Dungeon codes

  • SEASON3LIMITED: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND19: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • SEASON3EXPAND: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND18: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • SEASON2ENDING: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND17: 3 Race Reroll
  • SCYTHEWEAPON: 200 Origin Shards and 2 Race Reroll
  • NEWMAP: Free Rewards
  • CELEBRATEFOR150KMEMBER: Free Rewards
  • NEWMAPEXPAND: 2 Race Reroll and 200 Origin Shards
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND16: 3 Race Reroll FLAMES: 1x Limited Crate
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND15: Free Rewards
  • SEASON2EXPAND: Free Rewards
  • DMGHOTFIX: Free Rewards
  • SEASONSPINSSS: Free Rewards
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND14: Free Rewards
  • TGIFSEASON2: 5 Season Lucky Ticket
  • SEASON2GIFTA: 5 Season Lucky Ticket
  • SEASON2LIVE: 3 Season Lucky Ticket
  • IRONSOULWEEKEND13: 3 Race Reroll

Copy these codes exactly as shown. Iron Soul Dungeon codes are case-sensitive, and several older rewards have already moved out of the active pool.

Redeem the member and weekend codes first if you are short on time. Those are usually the rewards that disappear fastest after milestones or small patches.

Expired Iron Soul Dungeon codes

100KCONGRATS, IRONSOULWEEKEND12, GROCERYFIX, IRONSOULWEEKEND11, THURSDAYGIFT, 50KMEMBER, 40KMEMBER, 30KMEMBER, MEMBER20000, GOODJOB70KMEMBER, IRONSOULWEEKEND10, THXFOR60KMEMBER, HAPPYJUNE, MEMBER10000, IRONSOULWEEKEND8, IRONSOULWEEKEND7, IRONSOULWEEKEND5, IRONSOULWEEKEND4, IRONSOULWEEKEND3, MEMBER2500, WEEKDAYGIFT2, WEEKDAYGIFT1, IRONSOULWEEKEND2, IRONSOULWEEKEND1, NEWRELEASE, MEMBER1000, MEMBER500, MEMBER100, FIXINGPATCH, IRONSOULWEEKEND6, LIMITEDGIFT1, EXPEDITIONFIX

How to redeem Iron Soul Dungeon codes

The code menu sits behind the Discord icon, so it is easy to miss if you are only checking the main buttons. Finish the tutorial first if the code box is still locked.

  1. Open Iron Soul Dungeon on Roblox.
  2. Finish the tutorial if you are playing for the first time.
  3. Click the Discord icon in the top-right corner.
  4. Paste a working code into the Enter Code box.
  5. Press Confirm to claim your reward.

If the menu does not accept the code right away, rejoin the game on a fresh server before assuming the reward has expired.

Why is your Iron Soul Dungeon code not working

Start with the obvious checks first because most failed codes come from small typing mistakes or old servers.

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed the wrong capitalization, missed a number, or added an extra space.
  • You have already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • The code menu is still locked behind the tutorial.
  • You are on an older server that has not picked up the latest code changes.
  • Roblox or the Iron Soul Dungeon server is having a temporary issue.
  • The game is rate-limiting you after too many quick redemption attempts.

For long codes like IRONSOULWEEKEND9, copying is safer than retyping. If you see a “Too many actions” style error, stop redeeming for a short while, then try again.

Where to find more Iron Soul Dungeon codes

New Iron Soul Dungeon codes usually appear around player milestones, weekend events, patch fixes, and limited drops. These are the best places to watch:

  • Iron Soul Dungeon Roblox page
  • Iron Soul Discord server

Discord is useful if you want codes the moment they drop, but older rewards can linger across public lists after they stop working. You can bookmark this page if you prefer a cleaner active list without testing every expired weekend code yourself.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Immortality Incremental codes, Arcade Basketball codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Iron Soul Dungeon?

Iron Soul: Dungeon is a Roblox action RPG by Iron Soul where you clear dungeons, defeat monsters, collect crystallized ore, and forge stronger weapons. The game also has a skill tree, Race Rerolls, Cave Tickets, Lucky Tickets, and crafting resources that shape how your build grows.

Codes will not replace the dungeon grind, but they do give you a better start, especially when you need rerolls or extra tickets before pushing into harder runs.

title.rendered: 10 rarest Fortnite pickaxes and how players got them

content.rendered:
The pickaxe in Fortnite may be its most basic weapon, but it also undoubtedly plays an integral role in the game’s experience. Besides coming in handy for combat when you don’t have a gun equipped yet, it is primarily useful for dismantling objects and extracting vital resources from them, such as wood and metal. These are the commodities are key for building structures, which make a big part of the gameplay in certain Fortnite game modes.

Moving on from functionality, the pickaxe also has another noticeable role—doubling up as your style statement. There are tons of cosmetics available on Fortnite, which include a growing pool of pickaxe skins. So, you can equip one that matches your aesthetic preferences at any point before a match. The following list looks back on some of the rarest pickaxes that have appeared in Fortnite to date.

Top 10 rarest Fortnite pickaxes ever

1. Crowbar

Crowbar is a “rare”-type cosmetic from the early years of Fortnite. First made available in September 2018 (Season 5), it was up for grabs as a reward for completing all three quests in the High Stakes Challenges. It was also part of the Getaway Gang Set, which went live for 6,400 V-Bucks. Based on its high difficulty to unlock, it is not just considered very rare but also as among the toughest pickaxes to obtain.

2. AC/DC

This ‘Epic’ pickaxe is, as you might have guessed, an unofficial homage to the rock band known as AC/DC. It has only ever been available in Fortnite during Season 2 (December 2017–February 2018), as part of its Battle Pass rewards. More specifically, it was unlocked only by those who reached Tier 63 that season. Given its single-season availability from back during the game’s early years, it’s undoubtedly among the rarest Fortnite cosmetics today.

3. Diamond Jack

This is an Icon Series pickaxe that surfaced in Fortnite in April 2020, during the course of Chapter 2 Season 2. Regardless of what Diamond Jack’s jewel-studded look may suggest, it was actually available for relatively cheap at just 800 V-Bucks. After its original run, this pickaxe never returned to the fast-paced shooter game.

4. Merry Mint Axe

The Merry Mint Axe is an ‘Epic’-tier pickaxe that was made available in October 2019, during Chapter 2 Season 1. It was redeemable through a code that was tied to eligible Fortnite-licensed product purchases made at participating retailers, such as GameStop. With only a small portion of the current Fortnite player-base being able to lay claim, it is very rare to spot this pickaxe during matches.

5. Leviathan Axe

Leviathan Axe is the melee weapon used by Kratos in God Of War, a PlayStation console exclusive game. The namesake pickaxe in Fortnite is inspired by the same and debuted as part of the Gaming Legends Series line of in-game cosmetics.

Its first appearance was in December 2020, during Chapter 2 Season 5, and was selling in the Item Shop for 1000 V-Bucks. It could also be obtained, along with the Kratos skin, Mimir back bling, Guardian Shield glider, and Freezing Burst emote, from the Kratos bundle priced at 2200 V-Bucks. Since being phased out around the end of the season, Leviathan Axe hasn’t returned yet.

6. Pinpoint

Another pickaxe bundled with a licensed purchase, the Pinpoint is part of Epic Games’s partnership with Nintendo in late 2018. It was available for free for those who purchased a limited-time Fortnite edition of the Switch console, priced at $299.99. Other bundled items, besides the Pinpoint pickaxe, were the Double Helix skin, the Telemetry back bling, and the Rotor glider. It’s reasonable to say that being tied to a significant purchase made this pickaxe rank high in the rarity charts.

7. Stellar Axe

Nintendo wasn’t the only major company Epic Games did a sales promotion with in 2018; there was Samsung as well. And, Stellar Axe was an outcome of that very collaboration. It was available as part of a free cosmetics bundle for buyers of eligible high-end Samsung products, starting from $649.99. Apart from this pickaxe, the Galaxy skin, the Galactic Disk back bling, and the Discovery glider were also included. Today, Stellar Axe and the other bundled freebies are quite rare to spot online in Fortnite.

8. Throwback Axe

The Throwback Axe takes inspiration from a pickaxe that appeared in Fortnite’s first season. It was released in the Item Shop as a free-to-claim cosmetic in November 2020 (Chapter 2 Season 4). Around the middle of the successive season, this pickaxe promotion ended, and the Throwback Axe hasn’t gone up for sale again since.

9. Pointer

A big reason why Pointer is among the rarest pickaxes in Fortnite has to do with its China exclusivity. This pickaxe was only available to players of Fortnite China, a separate Chinese version of the game that Epic Games supported from 2018 to 2021. Since its discontinuation, Pointer has not been available in the market again.

10. Raider’s Revenge (Black & Gold edition)

Coming all the way from Season 1, Raider’s Revenge is among the oldest pickaxes in Fortnite. It was originally only available to level-35 players for 1,500 V-Bucks in the now-defunct Season Shop. Because this item of ‘Epic’ rarity returned in the OG Season Shop section in early 2026, Epic Games gave its existing owners an exclusive black-and-gold variant, which has since replaced the original as one of the rarest pickaxes in the game.

Variety of pickaxes in Fortnite

The different kinds of pickaxes mentioned in the list above are a reflection of their sheer variety in Fortnite. Thanks to the innumerable collabs and tie-ups Epic Games does for the game, this variety only keeps growing as years pass.

From Marvel to Star Wars to The Simpsons, a plethora of pop culture mainstays have rolled out themed content in the game. Moreover, real-life celebrities like Ariana Grande and John Cena have also been featured. Such team-ups have not only brought plenty of eye-catching pickaxes but also flooded Fortnite with special skins, gliders, back blings, among other things.

Given the frequency of such partnerships and the limited-time nature of some of them, players can expect more existing and future in-game items to become “rare” over time. Hence, if you want to own something like that, keeping tabs on Epic Games’s latest Fortnite collaborations emerges as imperative.

FAQs

How to unlock rare pickaxes in Fortnite?

While there is no guarantee of it, sometimes rare pickaxes do appear in the Item Shop and can be bought using V-Bucks.

Which special pickaxes are available in Fortnite?

Thanks to its various collabs and seasonal content refresh, Fortnite has accumulated multitudinous special pickaxes over the years.

Which are the hardest Fortnite pickaxes to get?

Some of the Fortnite pickaxes that have been very hard to come by for players are Crowbar, AC/DC, and Pinpoint.

title.rendered: I replaced my Pixel Watch 4 with Galaxy Watch 8: Here’s the real winner

content.rendered:
When I bought the Galaxy Watch 8, I thought it would be my smartwatch for years. It delivered excellent fitness tracking, lightweight comfort, and one of the best Wear OS experiences available. But then the Pixel Watch 4 arrived, bringing Google’s latest software features, AI-powered health coach, Satellite SOS, and tighter integration with Pixel phones.

So, I decided to compare my Galaxy Watch 8 with the Pixel Watch 4 to see if Google’s newest wearable was actually an upgrade in real-world use. Some improvements were immediately obvious, while other areas made me appreciate what Samsung got right.

If you’re looking for the best smartwatch for Android, here’s what I learned after making the switch and which one I think is the better buy.

Pixel Watch 4 vs Galaxy Watch 8: Quick comparison

Here are the key differences in specs:

My testing setup

To make this comparison as fair as possible, I used both the Pixel Watch 4 and Galaxy Watch 8 as my primary smartwatch for everyday tasks rather than relying solely on benchmark numbers or manufacturer claims.

During the testing period, I wore each watch throughout the day and overnight, tracking workouts, sleep, notifications, calls, navigation, and health metrics. I also tested battery life in different situations and paid close attention to the software experience.

My aim was not to compare which smartwatch offered the most features. Instead, I wanted to determine which smartwatch actually felt better to live with every day and whether switching from the Galaxy Watch 8 to the Pixel Watch 4 was worth it.

Design & comfort: Which one I actually wanted to wear

I expected the Galaxy Watch 8 to win this category.

Samsung’s redesign made the watch noticeably thinner than previous generations, and the flat-sided squircle look (“cushion design” in Samsung’s terms) gives it a more modern appearance. It feels premium, durable, and closer to a traditional watch than most smartwatches I’ve tested.

The Pixel Watch 4 takes a completely different approach. Google has stuck with its signature domed design with no visible frame. The curved bubble-like glass blends into the body, giving a minimalist all-screen look. It also made the screen easier to see from every angle. However, Pixel Watch 4 is a few grams heavier.

After wearing both for a few weeks, I found myself reaching for the Galaxy Watch 8. It looks slightly more substantial and professional, especially when paired with a metal band. Moreover, the dynamic lug system taken from Galaxy Watch Ultra made the dial move comfortably on your wrist. I almost forgot I was wearing it at times.

If you prefer a lightweight smartwatch for wearing all night, Samsung’s design is the better fit.

My winner: Galaxy Watch 8

Display and performance: The biggest daily difference

If there’s one area where I noticed a difference every single day, it was the display and overall responsiveness.

Both these watches feature superb AMOLED displays with up to 3,000 nits peak brightness. So, they are bright enough for outdoor use. The Galaxy Watch 8 uses Samsung’s proven Super AMOLED display, which delivers rich colors, deep blacks, and excellent visibility in direct sunlight. Text looks sharp, animations are smooth, and everything feels polished.

The Pixel Watch 4, however, impressed me more in daily use. Google’s brighter Actua 360 display made notifications, maps, and workout stats easier to read at a glance. Moreover, the edge-to-edge design offered more space on the screen despite the compact size of the watch.

Performance was equally close. The Galaxy Watch 8 felt incredibly fast when navigating thanks to the pinch gestures similar to Apple Watch’s Double Tap gesture. Moreover, I really loved the Universal Gestures to use the watch hands-free. Samsung’s One UI 8 also lets me stack multiple tiles on a single screen so I can check my metrics without opening all the apps.

Winner: Galaxy Watch 8

Health and fitness tracking: Surprisingly close

After several weeks of health tracking testing, the gap between the Pixel Watch 4 and Galaxy Watch 8 was much smaller than I anticipated. Both watches cover the basics, like ECG, temperature monitoring, and blood oxygen.

The Galaxy Watch 8 comes loaded with Samsung’s BioActive Sensor suite, giving it access to sleep monitoring, stress tracking, skin analysis, body composition scale, and a growing list of wellness and lifestyle insights. I was genuinely impressed by the amount of data. Moreover, the Galaxy AI acts as a running and sleep coach. And all of these are free to use.

The Pixel Watch 4 takes a different approach. Instead of overwhelming numbers, Google leans heavily on Fitbit’s health ecosystem. The new Google Health app focuses on presenting information in a way that’s easier to understand and act upon. Plus, the AI coach was like a personal trainer for me. But it needs Fitbit Premium ($9.99/month), similar to Apple Fitness+.

During my testing, both smartwatches showed almost identical results in terms of heart rate monitoring. As usual, the step counting also showed no significant differences, and GPS tracking proved reliable on both devices.

Winner: Galaxy Watch 8

Battery life: The reason most people will switch

Battery life was the first thing I paid attention to when comparing the Galaxy Watch 8 and Pixel Watch 4. Both have a 325mAh battery in the smaller version. But the 45mm Pixel Watch 4 has a 455mAh cell, whereas Samsung provided a 425mAh battery in the 44mm Galaxy Watch 8.

In my testing, both watches were capable of getting through a full day, even with sleep tracking enabled. My typical routine included notifications, message replies, workout tracking, GPS usage, music controls, and the Always On display. The Pixel Watch 4’s biggest improvement is that it goes up to 48hours with battery saver mode.

Charging speed also matters. The Pixel Watch 4 comes with an upgraded dock that charges the watch in an upright position as opposed to lying flat. I was still able to view the time, the remaining battery percentage, and my set alarms. It also charged noticeably faster in my testing. Starting at 5% battery, it reached 100% in just 43 minutes.

Samsung sticks with the traditional magnetic charging puck on the Galaxy Watch 8. It works perfectly well, but it doesn’t offer the same convenience or visibility while charging. Also, it took 64 minutes to reach a full charge.

Winner: Pixel Watch 4

Software experience: Pixel smart vs Samsung practical

The Galaxy Watch 8 runs Wear OS 6 with Samsung’s One UI 8 Watch interface layered on top. It packs extensive customization options, advanced health dashboards, deeper settings, and strong integration with Galaxy phones. You can also access Gemini for hands-free interactions via a customizable button.

The Pixel Watch 4 takes the opposite path. Google’s software feels cleaner, lighter, and more focused and cohesive. It integrates beautifully with Google Assistant, Maps, Calendar, and more. The biggest advantage of the Pixel Watch 4 is the raise-to-talk with Gemini and safety features like loss-of-pulse alerts and emergency satellite connectivity. 

You can make calls and contactless payments, and download apps from the Play Store for everyday convenience on both watches.

Winner: Pixel Watch 4 

What changed after switching

The biggest surprise after moving from the Pixel Watch 4 wasn’t a specific feature. It was how differently I interacted with my smartwatch throughout the day. 

With Galaxy Watch 8, I often found myself exploring features, checking health metrics, customizing watch faces, and tweaking settings. Samsung’s software encourages that kind of engagement because there’s always another feature to discover or another data point to analyze. However, it needs to be charged more frequently than the Pixel Watch 4.

The other major change was how often I used AI features. On previous smartwatches, voice assistants and AI coaches felt like a nice bonus. With Gemini and Galaxy AI, I found myself using voice interactions several times a day for reminders, quick questions, navigation, and fitness assistance.

You may like to read: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 vs Apple Watch Series 11

Which Android smartwatch should you buy?

After spending weeks with both watches, my answer is surprisingly simple.

Buy the Pixel Watch 4 if:

  • You deeply use Google services
  • You want better battery life
  • You want the cleanest Android smartwatch UI
  • You prioritize Fitbit-style wellness insights
  • You want the best accessory for your Pixel phone

Buy the Galaxy Watch 8 if:

  • You care about design first
  • You want reliability over aesthetics
  • You use your smartwatch heavily every day
  • You want the most complete Android wearable overall
  • You need seamless integration with Galaxy phones

Here’s the uncomfortable truth for Google fans: The Pixel Watch 4 is easier to admire, but the Galaxy Watch 8 is easier to live with. And in the long term, usability wins every time.

Final verdict: The eatch I’d actually buy with my own money

Seriously, I wanted the Pixel Watch 4 to win. It’s prettier, smarter in some ways, cleaner looking, and carries the stock Android feel of Google.

But after weeks of real usage, I’d still spend my own money on the Galaxy Watch 8. Samsung has built an incredibly polished wearable with excellent hardware, reliable health tracking, strong battery life, and one of the most mature smartwatch ecosystems available on Android.

Which Android smartwatch is your favorite? Let me know in the comments below!

Update: Verified the latest Demonfall Codes on August 02, 2026

Demonfall is a Roblox RPG inspired by Demon Slayer, where you choose to live as a Demon Slayer or walk the darker path as a demon. Progression can feel slow early on, which is why Demonfall codes matter. They give free rewards that save time, reduce grinding, and make progression smoother.

All Working Demonfall Codes

  • UPDATE6: Sabito Haori (NEW)
  • !update1: Sabito Haori
  • WeAreSoBACK!: Sabito Haori

Expired Demonfall Codes

!CODE 100KLIKES, !CODE 150KLIKES, !CODE BUGFIX, !CODE MAINTENANCE, !CODE RESETPOINTS, !CODE TWITTER1, !CODE UPDATE30, !CODE WIPEPOTION, !UPDATE30

Why Demonfall Codes Matter

Demonfall is built around long-term progression, and a single mistake can cost hours. Codes help avoid that setback by providing reset items and upgrade materials that make tougher fights manageable.

All rewards from codes are completely free. They remove the need to spend Robux and make progression fairer for both demon slayers and demons.

How to Redeem Demonfall Codes

Redeeming codes in Demonfall is simple, but the process depends on the game’s current system. The latest system uses the in-game settings menu.

Follow these steps to redeem your Demonfall codes correctly:

  1. Launch Demonfall through the Roblox player.
  2. Once inside the game, press the Tab key to open the menu.
  3. Click the gear icon to access the settings menu.
  4. Scroll down until you find the Promo Code field.
  5. Enter a working code and press Enter.

If the code is valid, the reward is credited to your account instantly. Since there is no confirmation message, always check your inventory to make sure the reward has been received.

If you play other Roblox anime games, do not miss our Funky Friday codes, Attack on Titan Revolution (AOTR) codes, and Anime Eternal codes for the latest free rewards and bonuses.

Why Your Demonfall Code Might Not Work

If a Demonfall code does not redeem, the issue is usually easy to fix.

First, Demonfall codes are case-sensitive, so even one wrong letter can cause failure. Copying and pasting the code directly is the safest option. Second, when new codes are released, the game often updates its servers. Waiting a few minutes after an update can solve the issue.

If the code still doesn’t work, it may have already expired. Codes in Demonfall don’t last long, and once they’re inactive, they cannot be redeemed again.

Where to Find New Demonfall Codes

New Demonfall codes usually appear during major updates, milestones, or holidays. To make sure you don’t miss them, here are the best places to keep an eye on:

  • Official Demonfall Discord server – This is where Fireheart Studio usually announces new codes first.
  • Fireheart Studio Roblox group – Updates and announcements are sometimes shared here.
  • Bookmark this page – We actively track all official announcements and update this guide as soon as new Demonfall codes are released, so you don’t have to search multiple platforms.

By bookmarking this page, you will always have the latest working Demonfall codes in one place, updated as soon as new ones go live.

Final Thoughts

Demonfall is more enjoyable when you spend time learning combat and progressing instead of worrying about mistakes or slow growth. Codes help keep the experience smooth.

If you haven’t redeemed the latest code yet, now is the perfect time. And if there are no active codes when you’re reading this, don’t worry. Demonfall always brings them back when players need them most.

Update: Verified the latest Grow a Garden Codes on August 04, 2026

Grow a Garden may look relaxed at first, but progress quickly slows once seeds, pets, and mutations start costing real effort. That is why Grow a Garden codes matter. They offer free cosmetics and occasional bonuses from official updates, helping you move forward without spending extra in-game currency.

All Active Grow a Garden Codes

  • RDCAward: Redeem for 1x RDC Award cosmetic (NEW)
  • BEANORLEAVE10: Redeem for 1x Green Bean Chamber cosmetic

Expired Grow a Garden Codes

LUNARGLOW10, TORIGATE

How to Redeem Grow a Garden Codes

Redeeming codes in Grow a Garden is one of the easiest parts of the game. You do not need to finish a tutorial or reach a certain level. You can redeem codes as soon as you load into the game.

Follow these steps carefully to avoid errors:

  1. Launch Grow a Garden from the Roblox launcher.
  2. Click the Settings or cog icon in the top left corner of the screen.
  3. Scroll until you see the code redemption box or the field that says something like “Type code here”.
  4. Enter the code exactly as it is written. Codes are case sensitive.
  5. Click Claim or Redeem.

Once redeemed, the reward is sent directly to your inventory.

If you see an invalid code message, double-check the spelling, ensure there are no extra spaces, and confirm the code has not expired.

For more game rewards, check out our guides for Borderlands 4 SHiFT codes, Basketball Legends codes, and MotoRush codes, all updated regularly with the latest working codes.

Where to Find New Grow a Garden Codes

Grow a Garden codes are released rarely, so it helps to know the right places to check. These options keep you updated without wasting time.

  • Join The Garden Game’s Roblox group – A simple way to follow updates and stay connected with the community.
  • Bookmark this codes page – New codes are added here as soon as they go live.
  • Join the official Grow a Garden Discord server – Developers share announcements, updates, and event news here.

Why Grow a Garden Codes Are So Hard to Find

Unlike many Roblox games that drop codes every week, Grow a Garden takes a slower approach. Codes usually arrive during big updates, seasonal events, or special milestones. For example, recent updates have focused on systems like the Smithing event, which added seed crafting, gear crafting, pet crafting, and new items like the Gem Egg.

Because of this, weeks can pass without any new codes. This makes each working code more valuable, especially for newer players who are trying to build momentum early in the game.

How to Get More Rewards Without Codes

Codes are helpful, but they are not the only way to get ahead in Grow a Garden. If you want more free rewards, there are a few things you should focus on daily.

Daily quests are the most reliable way to earn extra rewards. Completing them consistently helps you earn currency and progress faster without grinding endlessly.

Another smart trick is playing with friends. Friends can gift you high value crops, especially mutated ones, which sell for more money. This can give you a strong financial boost early on.

At the moment, these are the main non code methods available. The game is still fairly new, so more systems may be added in future updates.

Final Thoughts

Grow a Garden is meant to be calm, slow, and rewarding. But that does not mean you should ignore free bonuses when they are available. Codes may be rare, but they are worth redeeming every time they appear.

If you are just starting out, these small rewards can make the early hours feel less grindy. And if you are already deep into the game, limited cosmetics are always nice to collect.

Check back regularly, keep an eye on updates, and make sure you never miss a Grow a Garden code again.

  • Slap Battles Codes
  • Project Slayers Codes

Update: Verified the latest Sakura Stand Codes on June 01, 2026

If you’ve ever jumped into Sakura Stand and felt instantly overwhelmed, you’re not alone. The game looks flashy and exciting, but behind those anime-style effects is a heavy grind that can feel unforgiving, especially for new players. That’s exactly where Sakura Stand codes come in. These codes give you free Tokens, Cash, Boosts, Bloodstones, and EXP time, helping you grow stronger without hours of frustration.

Below, you’ll find all the latest working Sakura Stand codes, followed by expired ones, step-by-step redemption instructions, and tips to make sure your codes work the first time.

All Working Sakura Stand Codes

  • RTZREWORK: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • JOJOMONTH: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • deathduriyay67: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • SireisSupervision: Free Rewards
  • GrandOrder: Double EXP (250 minutes)
  • TypingMoon: Free Rewards
  • SaberFromSaberAlter: Double EXP (250 minutes)
  • SorryForDelay2: Free Rewards
  • ThisCantBeTheUpdateItsAllJustSkinsAnd: Free Rewards

Expired Sakura Stand Codes

100KLIKES, 15KUBSSOEPIC, 2MONTHSDELAY, 6COINS, AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA, AIZENINCIDENT, AMMDEVSFROMHEAVENSTANDOMG, ANARBITERAWAKENS, APRILFOOLS, ARISE, ARRIVALOFTHESKAFILMSHIRT1, AUDDYCOOKED, BATHESKI, BERUSTAND, BLUE LOCK STAND, BUGSFIX, BUGSFIX2, CARROTFROMTHATGAME, CHXMEIGIFT, CHXMEISAVEDTHEDAY, DEATHSTEP, DEMONKINGLOOKCUTETODAY, DIGITALCASH, EARLYD4C, ELECTRICCLAWS, ENTERCODEHERE, EVILQ3, EVILREST, FIDGETSPINNER.IO, FLANDRE, FOURTHSHUTDOWN, FREEADJUCHA, FREESFCVALUEPACK, GODGIVENBURGER, HAPPYEASTER, HAPPYHALLOWEEN!, HELLOHELLOHELLOIDK, HEROHUNTERFROMGUMBALL, HUECOMUNDOEXPANSION, IGRISSTAND, IMUSTBETHEREASONWHY, JUSTICE, KAFK-ISTHATTHEREDMIST, KAIJU-8, KINGOFHEROES, LOBSTERACTIVITY, LORDOFSAKURASTAND, MASTEROFSAKURASTAND, MBALL, MELTINGSNOW, MERRYCHRISTMAS, METAMORPHOSIS, MICHAELJACKSON, MOVE IT., PINPINPONPON, PROJECT EGOIST, RESTHASRESTED, ROARINGENGINE, ROBOTGIRL, SAKURABALLZ, SAKURAFINALLYADDEDSTAND, SAKURASTANDSOCIALEXPERIMENT, SCARLET, SFCOPEN4BUSINESS, SFCSPECIALCOUPON, SHATTERKYOKASUIGETSU, SJWUPDATE, SNOWINSUMMER?, SORRY4DELAY, SORRYFORDELAY1, SOUL DESTRUCTION, SPOOKYSPOOKYPLUSHIE, SRANKEDHUNTER, SUDDENLYASHUTDOWN, SUDDENSHUTDOWN, THE WONDER OF YOU, THECORNBUFF, THESTARRK, TOOMUCHSHUTDOWNX100, TOUHOU, TRICKOTREAT, ULTRASERVICE, UNIVERSALPIECE, VERYRANDOMCODE, WHISPERTEAM, WONDER OF U

How to Redeem Sakura Stand Codes

Redeeming codes in Sakura Stand is simple once you know where to look. Follow the steps below to claim your rewards in just a few seconds.

  1. Launch Sakura Stand on Roblox.
  2. Click the hamburger icon at the bottom-left.
  3. Open Settings.
  4. Paste the code in the Enter code section.
  5. Then press Enter.

That’s it. You will get your rewards instantly.

Looking for more freebies? Check out the latest Arise Ragnarok codes, Anime Crusaders codes, and Anime Eternal codes to unlock extra rewards and boosts.

Why Your Sakura Stand Codes Might Not Work?

If a code doesn’t redeem, it doesn’t always mean it’s broken. Sakura Stand codes are case-sensitive, time-limited, and sometimes locked behind mastery requirements.

  • The code may have expired
  • You might need a higher Mastery level
  • Some codes work only in new servers
  • Extra spaces or wrong capitalization can break the code

The safest way to redeem codes is to copy and paste them directly from the list.

How to Get More Sakura Stand Codes

New Sakura Stand codes are usually released during updates, shutdowns, events, or milestones. To stay ahead, join the Sakura Stand Community Discord, follow the Sakura Pro Max Roblox group, and bookmark this page so you never miss free rewards.

What Is Sakura Stand?

Sakura Stand is a Roblox fighting RPG inspired by JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure. You collect Stands, level up your character, unlock abilities, and fight powerful enemies across a growing anime-style world. Whether you play solo or with friends, the game rewards persistence, and these codes make that journey far more enjoyable.

Use the codes above, power up faster, and spend less time grinding and more time enjoying the fight.

In Case You Miss:

  • Plants Tower Defense Codes

  • Best Roblox Survival Games

  • Weak Legacy 2 Codes

How to Redeem Anime Crusaders Codes

Redeeming codes only takes a moment and happens directly inside the game lobby. You don’t need to open extra menus. Just walk to the right place and enter the code.

Here’s how to do it:

  1. Launch Anime Crusaders on Roblox.
  2. Walk to the Codes area near Summon in the lobby.
  3. Type any working code into the text box.
  4. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

Some codes need certain levels to work. If you get an error, your level might be too low.

Style Codes for the Game

These codes unlock exclusive character styles. Some are creator codes. They are free to redeem.

Follow32_A1, SubToZerozKinger, SubToCarson, SubToHW5567, SubToAdriansky, SubToShinobi, Flames, SubToRexon, SubToSUB4RU, SubToCaptKiddJr, SubToReycaju, SubToNagBlox, SubToPurple, SubToDevLuckk, SubToTigreTV, SubToPery, SubToHWxFade

Why Anime Crusaders Codes Might Not Work

Codes can fail for simple reasons. Most issues come from timing, level requirements, or small mistakes during entry.

  • Expired code. Many codes are time-limited and stop working after updates or event endings.
  • Level too low. Some codes require specific levels like 10, 15, or 25 before they work.
  • Typing mistake. Codes are case sensitive. Extra spaces or wrong characters make them fail. Copy and paste them.
  • Already used. Most codes can be redeemed only once per account.
  • Old server. New codes might not work on servers that haven’t restarted. Rejoin the game from the Roblox page.
  • Style codes. These unlock styles, not gems. They work even if you don’t see a reward pop-up.

If a code still fails after checking these points, it likely expired without notice.

How to Get More Anime Crusaders Codes

Anime Crusaders gets frequent updates, balance tweaks, and new events. Each major patch usually drops fresh codes, so staying connected helps you redeem them before they expire.

To stay updated:

  • Join the official Anime Crusaders Discord. Check channels like #codes, #announcements, and #update-log. Developers post new codes there first.
  • Follow the official Roblox group for Anime Crusaders. Some codes appear only in group posts.
  • Subscribe to the YouTube channel. Update trailers and patch videos sometimes include hidden codes.
  • Follow the official X account for live code drops during events or maintenance.
  • Bookmark trusted code pages and check regularly. Many codes expire in a few days or after a specific event ends.

These sources help you claim codes faster and avoid missing limited event rewards.

How Anime Crusaders Codes Help You

Anime Crusaders is all about optimizing your squad. Every unit has traits, stats, and growth paths. Rerolls let you try again for better traits. Gems let you summon new units. Stat cubes boost your unit stats directly.

These codes help you start strong. You can test more unit combos without grinding too hard. You also get rare materials like Perfect Stat Cubes and Mob Tokens in some codes. This can help you clear waves that usually demand more time.

Codes also help when major events drop. Seasonal codes often give large rewards. If you are early, you skip the huge grind wall and reach endgame faster.

Anime Crusaders makes every small stat change visible in your runs. Try different units and learn how traits change their power. Good rolls make weak units shine.

Play smart and redeem everything when it drops. That way, the game feels more about strategy than waiting for gems to refill.

These codes give you coins, class rerolls, stat resets, and event rewards, letting you fix build mistakes, try new classes, and progress faster without spending Robux. For new players, they provide a strong early boost. For returning players, they’re the quickest way to catch up after updates.

Expired Arise Ragnarok Codes List

How to Redeem Arise Ragnarok Codes in Roblox

Follow these steps exactly to avoid errors:

  1. Launch Arise Ragnarok on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Open the Shop menu on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Redeem.

If the code is valid, rewards are applied instantly.

Looking for more freebies? Claim bonuses in Dungeon Hunters codes, redeem the latest Borderlands 4 SHiFT codes, or pick up powerups with our Ghoul Re codes guide.

Common Arise Ragnarok Code Redemption Issues

Even valid Arise Ragnarok codes can fail if they are not entered correctly or if the game servers are not fully synced. Most redemption problems are minor and easy to fix once you know what causes them.

  • The code has expired or was already redeemed on your account
  • Incorrect capitalization, extra spaces, or formatting mistakes
  • Copy-paste errors, such as missing characters or hidden line breaks
  • Trying to redeem codes during server lag or immediately after an update

If a code does not work, recheck spelling, remove extra spaces, rejoin the server, and wait a few minutes after major updates before trying again.

What Are Arise Ragnarok Codes and How Do They Work?

Arise Ragnarok codes are developer-issued promotional codes that can be redeemed inside the in-game Shop. When redeemed, they instantly grant rewards to your account.

These rewards directly impact gameplay:

  • Coins: Buy gear and progression items faster
  • Class Rerolls: Change your class without restarting
  • Stat Resets: Rebuild your character properly
  • Event Rewards: Limited-time bonuses tied to updates

Codes are released by CLGAMES during updates, milestones, and events. They expire to keep rewards time-limited and prevent long-term balance issues.

Benefits of Using Arise Ragnarok Codes for Faster Progression

Using codes gives you practical advantages without spending Robux:

  • Faster early-game progression
  • Ability to fix build mistakes instantly
  • Freedom to test different classes
  • Reduced grinding for coins and resets

Codes are especially valuable after updates or when learning the game’s systems.

Where to Find New Arise Ragnarok Codes Safely

Developers release new codes on their social platforms:

  • Official Arise Ragnarok Discord (code-list channel)
  • CLGAMES Roblox group page
  • Developer social media accounts (X/Twitter, announcements)

You can also bookmark this page, as we regularly update this guide with the latest working Arise Ragnarok codes as soon as they are released.

Codes are usually released during updates, milestones, and events.

FAQ

Are Arise Ragnarok codes free?

Yes. All codes are free and require no Robux or real money.

How often are new codes released?

New codes typically appear during updates and milestone events, sometimes multiple times per week.

Update: Verified the latest SpongeBob Tower Defense Codes on July 09, 2026

If you’ve ever wanted to build your dream team of SpongeBob characters and defend Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob Tower Defense makes that possible and a bit chaotic. But here’s the catch: it’s a grind-heavy game, and pulling top units or getting enough loot takes time. That’s where codes come in.

The developers regularly drop codes that give you free rewards like Mythic Chests, Gold Trait Rerolls, and Secret Treasure Chests. How to Redeem Codes in SpongeBob Tower Defense

Redeeming codes isn’t available right away. You need to reach Level 10 in the game first. This encourages players to experience the game before collecting free loot.

Once you’re Level 10, here’s how to use the codes:

  1. Open SpongeBob Tower Defense on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop tab on the left.
  3. In the shop menu, press the Codes option.
  4. Enter the code exactly as shown (they’re case-sensitive).
  5. Hit Redeem and enjoy your freebies.

If you enter a code with a typo, it won’t work; you’ll get an “Invalid Code” message. Best to copy-paste directly.

Where to Find More SpongeBob Tower Defense Codes

There’s no strict schedule for new codes, but here are a few places where developers drop them:

  • WonderWorksRB on Twitter/X.
  • The official Krabby Krew Roblox Group.
  • The Krabby Krew Discord server, where codes are sometimes shared during events and patch drops.

You can also bookmark this page and check back here regularly for updates.

Quick Tip: What Makes These Codes Valuable?

If you’re new to the game, here’s why these codes matter:

  • Secret Treasure Chests can contain rare or exclusive units.
  • Mythic Chests offer better odds in the gacha system.
  • Gold Trait Rerolls let you re-roll unit traits to optimize performance.
  • Magic Conches and Exotic Chests are premium items not easy to grind.

Using these codes can save hours of farming, especially helpful if you’re trying to get stronger units or build a top-tier team faster.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

Bonus: What Are the Rarest Units in the Game?

There’s no official single “rarest” unit, but the S+ tier units are the hardest to pull and usually have the best stats. Some examples include:

  • Dream Gary
  • GG Rock SpongeBob
  • Cyborg Plankton
  • SpongeGar
  • The Quickster
  • Captain Magma
  • Sea Bear
  • Smitty Werbenjägermanjensen

These are extremely low drop-rate units, so save your best chests and rerolls for chances to get them.

Is SpongeBob Tower Defense Official?

Yes, this game is officially licensed and developed in partnership with the owners of the SpongeBob IP. That means all your favorite characters, from SpongeBob to Sandy to Patrick, are legit and legally used in-game. It’s not a fan-made copy; it’s the real deal.

If you’re ready to start building your Bikini Bottom dream team, don’t wait too long, these codes can expire at any time. Bookmark this page or check back weekly for the latest updates.

Want to stay ahead of the next update or boost your squad even more? Keep grinding, keep redeeming, and don’t forget to check out the Discord for insider news.

Update: Verified the latest Borderlands 4 SHiFT Codes on August 10, 2026

Borderlands 4 always rewards curiosity. Every corner might hide a gun that changes your whole build. SHiFT codes give that same excitement without any grinding. Each code gives a Golden Key or a cosmetic drop that feels like a gift for simply being part of the community. This guide covers all working SHiFT codes, how they work, and how to redeem them.

When you redeem a SHiFT code, you usually get Golden Keys. These unlock the Golden Chests found in major towns. Each chest gives high-tier loot, including Legendary Weapons, gear with traits that can shape a build, or cosmetics.

How SHiFT Codes Work

SHiFT codes are one time use rewards tied to your SHiFT account. When you enter a code, it claims the reward on your account and sends it to your Borderlands 4 profile on every linked platform. Golden Keys go into your backpack currency list.

Codes usually come from Gearbox social posts, Randy Pitchford on X, marketing emails, or events.

Golden Chests are found in major Faction towns:

  • The Launchpad
  • Carcadia
  • Belton’s Bore
  • The Lockaway

Each chest feels like a free pull in a loot machine, delivering rare gear that can change how your character plays.

How to Redeem SHiFT Codes In-Game

You can claim codes without leaving your session.

  1. Open Borderlands 4 and go to the pause menu.
  2. Select the SHiFT tab.
  3. Open Rewards.
  4. Enter your code and press Redeem.

If valid, your reward appears in your inventory. Golden Keys show in the backpack currency list.

How to Redeem SHiFT Codes Online

The browser method is useful if you’re not near your console.

  1. Go to the official SHiFT website.
  2. Log in to your account.
  3. Select Rewards.
  4. Enter the code and check it.
  5. Select your platform.

You can also scroll and see your full code history.

How to Create a SHiFT Account

You need a SHiFT account to redeem codes.

  • Visit the official SHiFT site.
  • Create an account with email or log in with Steam, Xbox Live, or PSN.
  • Confirm the email.
  • Link your platform under Gaming Platforms.

Always link the platform you play on so rewards go to the right character.

Bonus Rewards and Email Skins

SHiFT codes sometimes give more than keys. Cosmetics are common after events and promotions.

Before launch Gearbox ran a newsletter reward called Hazard Pay: a weapon skin sent to early subscribers. To get similar future rewards, opt in to:

  • News and promo messages from 2K
  • Gearbox newsletter

These options are in your SHiFT account under User Preferences.

Where SHiFT Codes Come From

SHiFT codes are always time-limited. They can drop from:

  • Randy Pitchford on X
  • Gearbox X account
  • Gearbox Facebook
  • Marketing emails
  • Community events

Because codes expire quickly, it’s worth checking trusted sites often. Many older codes listed online are already invalid.

Why Golden Keys Matter

A Golden Key run feels great. Borderlands 4 has new parts, new synergies between class builds, and legendary rolls that can define your whole route. Opening a Golden Chest saves hours of farming for players with limited time. It’s a bonus that rewards being connected to the Borderlands community.

So keep an eye on new codes on this page. A single drop might hand you a weapon that carries your build through a whole Vault session.

  • Attack on Titan Revolution codes
  • Project Egoist Codes
  • Type Soul Codes
  • Project Blue Lock Codes
  • Clover Retribution Codes

Update: Verified the latest Plants vs Brainrots Codes on August 02, 2026

If you grew up playing Plants vs Zombies, you’ll feel right at home in Plants vs Brainrots, a chaotic Roblox twist on the old classic. But instead of zombies, you’re up against goofy, fast-moving brainrots. The goal stays the same: defend your base with plants, but the vibe is pure Roblox. It’s messy, addictive, and way more fun with a few code-based freebies to help you survive those early rounds.

These codes give you a head start: free cash, potions, and grenades that boost your defenses without the early grind. Let’s walk through everything you need, from working codes to how to use them, plus where to find more as the game updates.

Active Plants vs Brainrots Codes

  • DISGUISE: Redeem for 1 Disguise Glasses
  • STONE: Redeem for 1 Medusa’s Head
  • STACKS: Redeem for 1 Lucky Potion
  • frozen: Redeem for 1 Frost Grenade
  • based: Redeem for 5000 Cash

Expired Plants vs Brainrots Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Codes in Plants vs Brainrots

You can’t redeem codes until you complete the short tutorial. Here’s how the process works:

  1. Launch Plants vs Brainrots and finish the tutorial (buy a seed and place it)
  2. Tap the red Shop icon on the left
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the shop menu and tap Codes
  4. Type or paste your code
  5. Hit the Claim button

That’s it. If the code doesn’t work, it’s either expired or already redeemed.

Troubleshooting Code Errors

If your code isn’t working, try these quick fixes:

  • Check spelling — codes are case-sensitive and spaces matter
  • Don’t reuse — most codes can only be redeemed once per account
  • Server delay — some codes only work after a fresh server update
  • Copy and paste — to avoid typos, don’t type manually

Still not working? It could have expired—come back to this page to double-check the status.

How to Get More Plants vs Brainrots Codes

New codes often drop during updates, community events, or surprise giveaways. Here’s where to check first:

  • Join the official Discord server
  • Follow the Yo Gurt Studio Roblox group
  • Bookmark this page and check weekly
  • Join 1 hour before updates — devs sometimes host admin abuse events that drop exclusive rewards

You can keep an eye on this page too. We keep track of all those sources and update this page when new codes drop.

Why Codes Matter in Plants vs Brainrots

This game gets intense fast. Brainrots scale in speed, strength, and weird abilities. You’ll need smarter plant combos, fusions, and map strategies just to survive later waves. Codes help you skip the boring parts and reach the fun stuff faster.

Free cash lets you experiment with new plants. Potions and grenades save you during tough waves. Together, they make the game more enjoyable—without removing the challenge. If you love the loop of upgrading, defending, and adapting, using codes just enhances the ride.

So go ahead, redeem the freebies, build your team, and take on the brainrot swarm. You’ve got this.

Update: Verified the latest Project Blue Lock Codes on August 10, 2026

Project Blue Lock is the kind of Roblox game that gets into your head fast. One great goal is all it takes to make you believe you can become the ultimate striker. But unlocking the best characters and traits takes spins, and spins take time. Codes fix that problem instantly. They give you a huge boost even if you’re a new player or someone trying to return after a break.

All Active Project Blue Lock Codes

  • KUON: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • BETRAYER: 5 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • WORSTPLAYER: 20 Spins (NEW)
  • 12AGAINST10: 20 Spins (NEW)
  • NEWCOMMON!: 20 Spins (NEW)

Expired Project Blue Lock Codes

FIRSTNEL, NELISAGI, TWINGUN, PUZZLEMASTER, ISAGI!, FIRSTGOALKEEPER, GOATMARU, BEAUTIFULSAVES, GAGA, MARU, ACESTRIKER, SENDOU!!, JAPANSBEST, HOLLYWOOD, U20, NARUHAYA, WATCHSTEP, FOOTSTEP, NEWCOMMON, BALANCING, KIYORA, ACROBATIC, BREAKDANCE, SPINNYSPIN, OTTOKUN, THENINJA, SNEAKY, OTOYAUPDATE, NINJA, 1KLIKES, 20SPINS, ADMINABUSE, AIKU, AIKUUPDATE, BAROU, BETTERGAME, BETTERLIFE, BK, BOTTLEOFWATER, BRUTAL, BUGFIXES, CHEEKYTUESDAYS, CHIGIRI, COBRA, COLDDD, CURVESHOTS, DEFENDER, DEVOUR, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT2, EXTRACAUSEWHYNOT3, FERNYAA, FIRSTQOL, FREEFREESPINS, FREELUCKYSPINS, FREEZING, GOALREACHED!, HERO, HIORI, HOMELESS, HYOMA, ICEMAN, IMPROVEGAME, INMYRANGE, ITOSHIRIN, JOINEVENT, KING, KINGOFTHEFIELD, KUNIGAMI, LOKI, LOKINEXT, LORENZO, LORENZOSFX, MADANURUI, MORESPINSPLEASE, NEWCHARACTER, NEWCHARACTER2, NEWCHARACTER3, NEWGEN, NEWRARITY, PACEONLY, PBL2RELEASE, PBL2TWITTER, PLEASEADMIN, PLEASEINEEDTHIS, PRINCESS, PXGMAESTRO, QOLUPDATESOON, READYFORSHIDOU, RYUSEII, SAE, SERPENT, SEVEN, SHIDOUU, SIX, SPEEDY, STRENGTH, SUBAA, SWISSTOSHI, THANKSLADS, THUUUNDER, TOKIMITSU, TWITTERWITTER, UHMISTHISOKAY, WANTSOMESPINS, WEBACK, WILDCARD, WINSOMEGAMES

How to Redeem Project Blue Lock Codes

Redeeming is simple and takes only a few seconds. You must join the Sub Studios Roblox group before redeeming.

  1. Open Project Blue Lock.
  2. Tap the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code.
  4. Tap Redeem to add the rewards instantly.

Tips For Faster Unlocks and Spins

Small habits make this game more rewarding.

  • Always redeem new codes before playing ranked, so your build gets stronger faster.
  • Save your spins for significant updates, since the strongest characters usually release with reworks.
  • Restart the game if a code doesn’t work, since the redemption window sometimes glitches.
  • Don’t settle for a mid-build. One lucky spin can completely change your gameplay experience.

Where to find future Project Blue Lock codes

Codes drop often and usually appear during significant character updates, patches and milestone celebrations.

  • Project Blue Lock Discord server.
  • Developer announcements.
  • In-game update notes after major patches.

Make sure to bookmark our site because we update this page the moment new codes drop, so you never miss free spins.

Project Blue Lock gets better when you feel your growth match after match. Codes make the grind smoother so you can focus on scoring goals, unlocking rare characters and playing your own version of the Blue Lock dream. Keep checking for new codes and build the strongest player you can.

How to Redeem Volleyball Legends Codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look. Follow these steps:

  1. Open the Volleyball Legends game on Roblox.
  2. Tap on the Shop icon at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Select the Codes option on the left side.
  4. Type or paste your code into the box.
  5. Click Use Code to claim your reward.

If the code is valid, you’ll see a green confirmation message. If it’s invalid, it means the code has either expired or was typed incorrectly.

Why Volleyball Legends Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail even if you think it should work. Here are the common reasons:

  • The code has already expired.
  • The code was typed incorrectly. Codes are case-sensitive, so make sure every letter and symbol matches exactly.
  • Extra spaces before or after the code can cause errors.

To avoid problems, it’s best to copy and paste the code directly.

How to Get New Volleyball Legends Codes

If you don’t want to miss out on future rewards, here’s where to look:

  • Join the official Volleyball Legends Discord and check the announcements channel for updates.
  • Follow the developer @Protori_ on Twitter/X for surprise code drops during events or milestones.
  • Bookmark this article, and we will keep it updated so you won’t miss any new rewards.

Final Thoughts

Volleyball Legends codes are the easiest way to unlock spins, test new playstyles, and power up your character, whether you want to dominate as a spiker, blocker, or setter. Just remember, codes don’t last forever. Redeem the latest ones now, and keep checking official channels to stay ready for the next update.

How to Redeem Blue Lock Rivals Codes

It’s super easy, here’s how:

  1. Reach Level 10 in Blue Lock Rivals (play matches and complete quests to level up).
  2. Join the official Blue Lock Rivals Roblox group
  3. Launch Blue Lock Rivals on Roblox.
  4. In the lobby, click the Codes button at the bottom of your screen.
  5. Enter your code exactly as shown and hit Redeem.
  6. Enjoy your rewards!

Why Isn’t My Blue Lock Rivals Code Working?

Happens to me too, usually when I am juggling my iPhone and Mac and trying to redeem fast. Codes can be fussy, even when you do everything right.

Here’s your go-to checklist:

  • Typos and Spaces: Codes are picky. I copy from Notes and paste with Handoff, then I look for sneaky spaces at the start or end, especially if I pulled the code from Discord.
  • Code Expiry: Some codes disappear without a heads up. If it fails, I check the post date in announcements and recent tweets to see if that window already closed.
  • Eligibility Requirements: You must be Level 10+ and a member of the official group. I double check the account I am on, because I sometimes swap alts on my iPhone and forget.
  • Region/Server Restrictions: A few codes only work on certain servers or for brand new players. I skim the event notes and ask in Discord to confirm before I burn time testing.
  • Restart the Game/App: A quick restart helps more than you would think. I force quit Roblox on iPhone, reopen, and try the code again.
  • Update Your Game: Make sure you have the latest build. I open the App Store, refresh updates, and grab the newest version before I retry.
  • Try Another Device: If nothing sticks, I redeem on my iPad or Mac. Clipboard sync makes it painless, and it rules out a device bug.
  • Contact Support: Still stuck. Hit the in-game Help Center or the official Discord. I include a timestamp, a screenshot of the error, and my level so they can see the context fast.

Quick Troubleshooting Table

What is Blue Lock Rivals?

Blue Lock Rivals is a competitive football (soccer) game on Roblox, a place where you build your dream team with characters pulled from the Blue Lock anime world. With bold anime visuals, lively match cutscenes, and smart team-building, you will recruit and train iconic players, try new tactics, and face rivals from across the globe in real-time PvP matches on iPhone or iPad.

Key Gameplay Features

  • Recruit and Train Players: Collect fan favorites from Blue Lock and level them up through training and upgrades. I usually pour early points into a striker slot on iPhone, quick taps make the finish feel snappier.
  • Tactical Team Building: Mix and match formations, assign special skills, and build team chemistry that is hard to break. On iPad, the bigger view makes dragging roles and swapping players feel cleaner. 
  • Real-Time PvP Matches: Test your skills against real players in fast, action-heavy matches that reward timing and positioning. Touch controls feel tight, and on high refresh screens the motion feels extra smooth.
  • Spins System: Use Lucky Style Spins and Lucky Flow Spins to unlock new moves, playstyles, and cosmetics. Think pulls with a little suspense, made better with a quick Haptic Touch buzz when a good one lands. 

Who Plays Blue Lock Rivals?

This game draws a passionate crowd, mostly anime and sports fans, with plenty of Roblox players in the mix (ages 12 to 30, if you’re curious, and yes, tons on iPhone during commute hours). Whether you’re here for strategy, the rush of fast plays, or to collect your favorite strikers, you’ll find a lively, welcoming community in official channels and fan spaces, with tips flying in Discords and App Store reviews that read like quick sideline chats. 

What Are Blue Lock Rivals Codes?

Think of these as little gifts from the developers, special codes released during updates, milestones, or limited events. Enter one and you can grab free items like Lucky Style Spins, Lucky Flow Spins, and sometimes straight cash boosts. These codes give you a head start that would otherwise take a lot of grinding, and yes, I keep a pinned Note on iPhone so I can paste new codes in fast from Mac with Universal Clipboard. 

What Do They Unlock?

Blue Lock Rivals codes are special promo codes released by the developers during updates, milestones, or events. Redeem them for: 

  1. Lucky Style Spins: Unlock new character styles and moves. Run a quick match to feel the change before you invest resources.
  2. Lucky Flow Spins: Add new flow abilities and effects. Worth saving for patches that shift the meta, then roll when the pool changes.
  3. Cash/Cash Boosts: Extra in-game currency for upgrades. Great for power leveling a striker, and using Notes helps track spending if the grind starts pulling you in.
  4. Exclusive Rewards: Sometimes unique cards or cosmetics, often tied to events. Some are limited, so do not sit on them. 
Pro Insight: If you’re a planner (like me), save your spins for when new styles or flows are added to the game. That way, you can maximize your odds of landing something rare or meta-changing.

When Do New Blue Lock Rivals Codes Release?

I keep an eye out for new codes during:

  • Major updates or new content releases, I scan patch notes, App Store update logs, and Discord announcements on my iPhone and Mac.
  • Special occasions (anniversaries, holidays) devs often drop celebratory codes.
  • Big milestones (visits, likes, etc.)

More Ways to Get Freebies (Beyond Codes)

Don’t just wait for codes! There are plenty of ways to stack up rewards in Blue Lock Rivals: 

  • Daily Logins: Pick up cash, spins, and sometimes special items just for showing up.
  • Leveling Up: Get resources as you hit new milestones.
  • Quests & Achievements: Completing these means more currency and spins.
  • Special Events: Jump into seasonal or milestone events for exclusive goodies. 
  • Community Giveaways: Keep an eye on Discord and social channels, sometimes there are surprise drops!
Expert Tip: Time your code redemptions with in-game events or boosts. For example, use cash boosts during double-reward weekends, or spend spins right after new styles are added.

Where to Find New Blue Lock Rivals Codes

Never want to miss a code drop? Here is how I stay in the loop, and you can too:

  • Discord Server: The Blue Lock Rivals Discord is usually the fastest place for fresh codes, developer news, and giveaways.
  • Reddit: r/BlueLockRivals is great for tips, memes, and code sharing.
  • YouTube: Some gaming creators share codes in their videos.
  • Trello Board: Blue Lock Rivals Trello is regularly updated with new codes, patch notes, and event details.
  • Roblox Group & Game Page: Sometimes, codes show up in the Roblox group or as announcements on the Blue Lock Rivals game page.

Why join?

  • Get notified about new codes instantly, keep the announcements channel on alerts so I can paste a code from Notes in seconds.
  • Participate in Q&As, giveaways, and tournaments, add the date to Calendar and jump in from whatever device is charged.
  • Team up for in game events, match finder channels make it easy to build a squad fast.

Similar Games to Try

If you’re hooked on Blue Lock Rivals, you might also enjoy:

  • Azure Latch: A football game with anime style. The pace works for shorter sessions, and hopping in on 5G stays smooth on iPhone, even on busy networks.
  • Meta Lock: A fresh take on the genre with distinct mechanics. I test builds here when I want a rhythm change, then carry key ideas back to Rivals. 
  • Skillful: For players who want a different flavor of anime sports action. I run it on my Mac in Safari, controller plugged in, and the performance feels steady. 
Pro Tip: Set notifications for official accounts and bookmark this guide—trust me, you’ll thank yourself later.

Best Blue Lock Rivals Codes Ever (Highlights)

Some of the most popular codes from past events have included, and I still keep screenshots of the good ones in Photos so I can remember what I pulled:

  1. BACHIRA!!: 15 Lucky Style Spins, easy to bank a handful of early rerolls on iPhone, and the pull list still lives in a Notes log.
  2. REVAMP!: 10 Lucky Flow Spins, great for testing a fresh flow, run these right after an update to lock a build that can carry ranked.
  3. OTOYA!!: 15 Lucky Style Spins, another stash for cosmetics and moves, try one match first, then decide where to invest. 
  4. KING1.5M: 10 Lucky Spins, 10 Flow Spins, a balanced drop that lets you chase a style while rolling for a flow on the side.
  5. LUCKYCODE10: 10 Lucky Style Rerolls, 5 Flow Rerolls, especially handy during patch weeks when the pool shifts and you want a quick reset.

Redeeming codes regularly can speed up progress, set a small Reminder on iPhone so you do not forget.

Code Safety: Don’t Get Scammed

A quick word of caution:

  • Skip third party code generators, they are usually scams and could compromise your account. If a site asks for your Roblox username or wants odd installers, close the tab. Keep a content blocker on in Safari if you tend to go link hopping.
  • Stick to official or trusted sources. Turn on Discord announcements, check the Roblox group, and cross check with the Trello board. If you grab a code from Reddit or YouTube, scan comments first.
  • Never share your Roblox login info for free rewards. Turn on two factor auth, keep a PIN, and let iCloud Keychain auto fill only on the real roblox.com domain. 
  • See something sketchy? Report it to the community to help keep everyone safe. Take a screenshot, share the link in Discord, and use the in game report tools. 

Conclusion: Don’t Miss Out on Freebies!

Blue Lock Rivals is one of the most fun anime football games around, and codes are your quickest path to big rewards. Stay sharp, redeem early, and keep building that dream team. And hey, if you spot a fresh code, share it with the community and keep this guide handy, we all level up faster when everyone pitches in.

Official Links and Support:

  • Roblox Group: Blue Lock Rivals Official Group
  • Trello: Blue Lock Rivals Trello
  • Discord: Blue Lock Rivals Discord

Bookmark this page for the latest Blue Lock Rivals codes and updates!

Thanks for reading, and see you on the pitch!

FAQs

Are Blue Lock Rivals codes free?

Yes. Official codes are free to claim, no payments or extra tools required. 

Can I share codes with friends?

Yes, though most codes are single use per account. If someone has already redeemed it, it will show as used. 

How often are new Blue Lock Rivals codes released?

New codes usually appear with big updates, holiday or anniversary events, and milestone hits for visits or likes. There is no fixed schedule, but fresh codes tend to show up about once or twice a month, with occasional surprise drops during community events. 

Why isn’t my code working?

Check spelling and letter case, then check expiry. Some codes need you to join the Roblox group or be on a specific server. Update the game, restart your session, and try again if a temporary issue is suspected. 

Are there region-specific codes?

Sometimes. A few promos only work in certain regions or servers, so switching servers can help. 

Can I use codes on both PC and mobile?

Yes. Codes work across platforms, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, PC, and Android. 

What should I do if none of the solutions work?

Contact support through the in-game Help Center or post in the official Discord for help. Do not share your login details, and attach a quick screenshot of the error to speed things up.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: WhatsApp for mac could soon get Apple’s Liquid Glass refresh

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is reportedly working on bringing Apple’s Liquid Glass design language to its Mac app, making the messaging platform feel more aligned with the look and feel of modern Apple software.

The feature was spotted by WABetaInfo, which says the redesign is currently under development and not yet available to beta testers.

WhatsApp’s Mac app may get a visual refresh

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is preparing a new interface for macOS that more closely aligns with Apple’s Liquid Glass design language introduced in its latest software updates.

The redesign is expected to bring:

  • More translucent interface elements
  • Glass-like visual effects
  • Updated navigation components
  • An interface that feels more in line with modern macOS apps

The redesign is not particularly surprising, since WhatsApp’s Mac app already shares much of its underlying framework with the iPad version through Apple’s Catalyst technology.

As a result, incorporating more Liquid Glass-inspired components could help WhatsApp feel more at home alongside Apple’s latest software releases.

Meta has been gradually updating WhatsApp’s design

Meta has already been testing Liquid Glass-inspired changes in WhatsApp for iPhone, including updates to chat screens, navigation bars, reaction menus, and message controls.

Bringing those changes to Mac could make WhatsApp feel more integrated within Apple’s ecosystem.

Based on what has been discovered so far, the update appears to focus more on appearance rather than introducing major new features. It could make the app look more consistent with modern macOS apps that are gradually adopting Apple’s newer design language.

The feature is still under development, and Meta has not shared a timeline for beta testing or public availability. That means the final design could still change before it reaches users.

For now, it looks like WhatsApp for Mac could be the next part of Meta’s app lineup to receive a visual overhaul.
