aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: New Apple TV and HomePod mini are reportedly almost ready, but Siri may be the hold-up

content.rendered:
Apple’s next Apple TV and HomePod mini may already be close to launch from a hardware standpoint. The bigger question now seems to be when Apple’s new Siri and Apple Intelligence experience will be ready to make them feel new.

According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the next Apple TV set-top box and HomePod mini are “nearly ready” and have been used by Apple employees for months. Apple has not announced either product yet, so this is still a report rather than confirmed launch timing.

The timing makes sense. Apple’s WWDC 2026 keynote is scheduled for June 8 at 10 a.m. PT, where the company is expected to preview iOS 27, tvOS 27, and its next wave of Siri and Apple Intelligence features.

Apple may be waiting for the new Siri story

Gurman’s report suggests the hardware itself is not the main blocker. Instead, Apple appears to be holding the devices until the software side is ready, especially the new Siri experience expected later this year.

That matters because Apple TV and HomePod mini both sit at the center of the home. A smarter Siri could make the HomePod mini feel less like a tiny speaker with voice commands and more like a useful home assistant. On Apple TV, better Siri could improve search, navigation, smart home control, and quick answers from the couch.

It also fits the broader iOS 27 Siri overhaul Apple is expected to show at WWDC. Recent reports point to a more capable assistant with a dedicated app, better context handling, and deeper system integration. If Apple wants its home devices to be part of that reset, launching them before the software is ready would blunt the pitch.

The hardware may be a practical refresh

The next Apple TV is not expected to be a dramatic redesign. Gurman says he would not expect huge hardware changes beyond the new chip, though the Siri Remote may also be refreshed in some form.

That still leaves room for a meaningful upgrade. The current Apple TV 4K dates back to 2022, and a newer chip could make the box faster, more efficient, and better prepared for future Siri, smart home, and gaming features. A better Siri Remote would also be welcome, especially if Apple wants voice search and assistant controls to feel central again.

The HomePod mini refresh is overdue in a more obvious way. The original model launched in 2020, and Apple has mostly kept it alive through color changes and software updates. A new model would likely focus on a faster chip and better wireless performance, while keeping the small design and $99-style positioning that made the mini easy to recommend. The latest report gives fresh weight to the long-running HomePod mini 2 expectations, but Apple has not confirmed the final specs.

WWDC should make the launch window clearer

The safest read is that Apple has the living-room hardware close to done, but wants the launch to line up with the bigger Siri and Apple Intelligence push. That points to a fall release window, assuming the software lands on schedule.

For users, the key question is not just whether Apple ships a faster Apple TV or a refreshed HomePod mini. It is whether Siri finally becomes useful enough to make those devices feel smarter in daily use. WWDC should tell us how close Apple is to that promise.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t my code working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check spelling and letter case, then check expiry. Some codes need you to join the Roblox group or be on a specific server. Update the game, restart your session, and try again if a temporary issue is suspected.

mainEntity.name: Are there region-specific codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes. A few promos only work in certain regions or servers, so switching servers can help.

mainEntity.name: Can I use codes on both PC and mobile?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if none of the solutions work?

Below, you will find a live list of working codes, quick steps to redeem them, and a few ways I track new drops, so you keep the rewards flowing while you defend your base and climb the leaderboards.

What is Anime Vanguards?

Anime Vanguards is a Roblox tower defense game where you collect, and upgrade characters inspired by big name anime. I build a squad, drop units on the path, and try to keep the base safe as the waves stack up. Simple loop. Surprisingly tense. You place, you time skills, you chase that next upgrade.

New abilities unlock as you progress, and regular updates plus weekend events keep things lively. I usually play on my iPhone, then hop to the iPad for longer sessions. Codes help a lot, quick boosts like gems, coins, and trait rerolls when you need them.

How Do Codes Work in Anime Vanguards?

  1. Gems: Used to summon new characters.
  2. Coins/Gold: For upgrades and purchases.
  3. Trait Rerolls: Change your characters’ traits for better stats.
  4. Stat Chips & Essence Stones: Boost your units’ abilities.
  5. Event Items: Special items are only available for a limited time.

Note: Some codes may require your account to reach a specific level before redemption.

How to Redeem Codes in Anime Vanguards?

Redeeming codes is quick and easy. Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Anime Vanguards on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Codes icon—usually a purple button on the right side of the screen or sidebar.
  3. Click the Codes icon to open the code entry window.
  4. Type or paste your code into the “Enter code…” field. Make sure there are no extra spaces and that the code is entered exactly as shown.
  5. Click the Redeem Code button. If the code is valid and you meet any level requirements, your rewards will be added to your account automatically.

Pro Tip: Copy and paste codes directly from trusted sources to avoid typos.

Advanced Troubleshooting Code Redemption Issues

AQuick fixes first, deeper checks second. I run these on iPhone and iPad, then verify once in a desktop browser. 

  • Double check the code: Case sensitive, every character must match. I paste from Notes, then tap backspace to clear a hidden newline from Discord. 
  • Check for extra spaces: Trim spaces before you hit Redeem. iOS sometimes adds one after a prediction, tiny thing that breaks entry. 
  • Confirm code status: Many codes are time limited or tied to events. Check the timestamp where you found it, then retry on a fresh server. 
  • Meet level requirements: Some codes only trigger after you reach a level or clear a tutorial. I use an alt on iPad to confirm a gate before giving up. 
  • Stable connection: Unstable network means unstable redemption. Toggle Wi Fi, cycle mobile data, and turn off Low Data Mode. 
  • Try a different device or browser: If the app errors or ignores input, force quit and relaunch. Still stuck, switch devices or try a desktop browser. 
  • Check for server maintenance or outages: Sudden failures can mean maintenance. Peek at the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Busy lobbies can be flaky. 
  • Update your game client: Install the latest build. Older clients misbehave. A clean reinstall also clears stale data that blocks forms. 
  • Account restrictions: Rare, but Screen Time or family settings can block entry. Review device limits, then check Roblox account settings. 
  • Contact support with evidence: If a valid code still fails, capture a screenshot or short screen recording. Include server, platform, and time. 

Expert insight: During major updates or live events, the code service can lag behind the game. If a new code will not validate, wait a few hours, then try again. 

If you tried all of the above and the code still will not be redeemed, it is likely expired or already at its usage limit.

Where to Find More Anime Vanguards Codes?

Stay ahead by checking these official and reliable sources for new codes:

  1. Official Discord Server: Join the Anime Vanguards Discord and monitor the #announcements channel for the latest codes and news.
  2. Official Twitter: Follow @AnimeVanguards for updates and code drops.
  3. Game’s Roblox Page: Sometimes codes are posted in the game’s description or update logs.
  4. YouTube/Twitch: Some content creators and streamers reveal exclusive codes during live events.

Warning: Avoid using codes from unofficial or suspicious sources to keep your account safe.

Additional Free Rewards (Beyond Codes)

Besides codes, Anime Vanguards offers other ways to claim free rewards:

  1. Mailbox Rewards: Occasionally, the developers send out gifts (like Phoenix Shards or Elemental Shards) via the in-game mailbox. Click the Mailboxbutton (usually bottom-right), select new mail, and click Claim or Claim All.
  2. Daily Login Bonuses: Log in each day to earn free gems, coins, or other resources.
  3. Special Events: Participate in limited-time events for exclusive rewards.

Stay Ahead in Anime Vanguards

Anime Vanguards codes are my shortcut to faster upgrades, stronger units, and the odd exclusive that saves a run. I grab them while they are live, paste from Notes on my iPhone, then test on iPad if a pop up stalls. Keep an eye on the game’s official channels for fresh drops and patch notes. When a wave spikes, those freebies matter. Small boosts. Real wins. 

Bookmark this page and keep it handy in Safari. I keep it pinned next to the Discord link, then I pop back to check new codes before a session. Come back often and stay ahead. 

Visit the updated Roblox game codes list for the newest rewards.

FAQs

How often are new codes released?

New codes usually land during big updates, community milestones, or limited events. I check weekly, then again right after a patch. Quick sweep.

Are codes region-locked?

No. Anime Vanguards codes are available globally.

Can I reuse expired codes?

No. Once a code expires it will not be redeemed again. Even if it worked earlier for someone else, the window closes.

Can I redeem codes on mobile?

Yes, codes can be redeemed on both PC and mobile devices.

What should I do if a code doesn’t work?

Check spelling, confirm any level requirement, and verify the code is still valid. Make sure your connection is stable. Then see troubleshooting above.

Are there level requirements for some codes?

Yes. A few codes require a specific account level, and we note that next to each affected code.

What if I encounter a unique code issue?

Share details in the comments or on our Discord. Include a screenshot or short screen recording. Your note can help others, and we will update the guide.

"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

Update: Verified the latest Parkour Champions Codes on June 01, 2026

Parkour Champions is a fast-paced, anime-styled obstacle racing game on Roblox where movement is everything. You sprint, wall-run, jump, and glide through intense courses using abilities inspired by iconic anime champions.

This is where Parkour Champions codes come in. These free rewards give you coins, Champion Spins, Spirit Spins, and Super Spins, helping you unlock stronger champions and progress faster without heavy grinding.

Below, you’ll find a verified list of working codes, step-by-step redemption instructions, and tips to find new codes before they expire.

Latest Working Parkour Champions Codes

  • UPD1: 3 Super Champ, 3 Super Enchant Spins and 25,000 coins (NEW)

Expired Parkour Champions Codes

100K, DELAYCHAMPIONS, LAUNCH, LOVE, PARKOUR, PRESENT, RELEASE, SANTA, SEEUSOON, TEST2, THANKU, WELCOME

What Are Parkour Champions Codes?

Parkour Champions codes are free promotional rewards released by the developer, Studio 8K, to help players progress faster.

These codes give useful in-game items like coins, Champion Spins, Spirit Spins, and Super Spins. Coins are used for upgrades and enchants, while spins help you unlock new champions and spirits, with Super Spins offering better chances at top-tier units.

New codes are usually released during game launches, major updates, bug fixes, milestones, and community events. Each code is time-limited and can only be redeemed once per account, so it’s best to claim them as soon as they go live.

How to Redeem Parkour Champions Codes

Redeeming codes in Parkour Champions is simple, but you must complete or skip the tutorial first.

Once you’re in the game, follow these steps carefully.

  1. Launch Parkour Champions on Roblox.
  2. Complete or skip the tutorial.
  3. Click the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Press Claim Code.

Valid codes add rewards instantly to your inventory.

If you enjoy games like this, check out our latest Anime Crusaders codes, Hunty Zombie codes, and All Demonfall codes for more free rewards and boosts.

Tips for Finding New Parkour Champions Codes

New codes don’t follow a fixed schedule, so knowing where to look is key.

  • Bookmark reliable Parkour Champions code pages and check them regularly.
  • Revisit code sources after every game update or announcement.
  • Watch for codes shared during milestones and special events.
  • Copy and paste codes instead of typing to avoid errors.
  • Redeem codes as soon as you find them before they expire.

Follow Official Channels for Code Updates

Official channels are the fastest and most reliable source for new Parkour Champions codes.

  • Join the Parkour Champions Discord server for instant announcements and code drops.
  • Follow the Studio 8K Roblox group to stay updated on milestones and updates.
  • Check the official social links listed on the game’s Roblox page.

Alternatively, you can just bookmark this page and check it. We update this page when new codes are listed by the developers.

Join Gaming Communities for Extra Rewards

Joining the Parkour Champions Discord helps you stay connected and improve faster.

  • Early access to new and unreleased codes.
  • Discord-exclusive rewards and giveaways.
  • Gameplay tips from experienced and competitive players.
  • Update news, sneak peeks, and developer announcements.

At times, invite-based exclusive codes are shared that reward players for bringing friends into the server. Staying active increases your chances of grabbing these limited bonuses before anyone else.

Common Issues and How to Fix Them

If a code doesn’t work, it’s usually due to a small and easily fixable issue.

  • Typing errors: Always copy and paste codes exactly as shown
  • Case sensitivity: Codes must match uppercase and lowercase letters perfectly
  • Expired codes: Time-limited codes stop working once they expire
  • Already redeemed: Each code can only be used once per account
  • Tutorial not completed: The Codes button appears only after skipping or finishing the tutorial

Fixing these issues resolves most redemption problems.

Conclusion

Parkour Champions codes are one of the fastest ways to progress and unlock powerful champions without excessive grinding.

Because codes expire quickly, redeem them as soon as they release and check back often for updates.

FAQs

How often are new Parkour Champions codes released?

There is no fixed schedule. New codes are released during updates, milestones, and community events, sometimes multiple times a month.

Can expired Parkour Champions codes be reused?

No. Once a code expires or is redeemed, it cannot be used again. The only solution is to wait for new codes from the developers.

  • Ghoul Re Codes
  • Dungeon Hunters Codes
  • Dueling Grounds Codes
  • Anime Final Quest Codes

mainEntity.name: Are codes region-locked?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Anime Vanguards codes are available globally.

mainEntity.name: Can I reuse expired codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once a code expires it will not be redeemed again. Even if it worked earlier for someone else, the window closes.

mainEntity.name: Can I redeem codes on mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, codes can be redeemed on both PC and mobile devices.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if a code doesn't work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check spelling, confirm any level requirement, and verify the code is still valid. Make sure your connection is stable. Then see troubleshooting above.

mainEntity.name: Are there level requirements for some codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A few codes require a specific account level, and we note that next to each affected code.

mainEntity.name: What if I encounter a unique code issue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share details in the comments or on our Discord. Include a screenshot or short screen recording. Your note can help others, and we will update the guide.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Parkour Champions codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes are released during updates, milestones, and community events, sometimes multiple times a month.

mainEntity.name: Can expired Parkour Champions codes be reused?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Once a code expires or is redeemed, it cannot be used again. The only solution is to wait for new codes from the developers.

title.rendered: iOS 28 rumors surface before Apple even unveils iOS 27

content.rendered:
Apple may already be looking beyond iOS 27. According to Mark Gurman, the company expects iOS 28 to be a much bigger release than next year’s update.

First iOS 28 rumor is already here

In his Power On newsletter, Gurman says Apple’s 2027 software releases are expected to be more ambitious than the updates arriving in 2026.

Internally, Apple is reportedly using the codename “Bell” for iOS 28 and ‘Poppy” for macOS 28.

The timing of the report is notable because Apple hasn’t even unveiled iOS 27 yet. Hearing that the following year’s update could be more significant suggests the company may already be planning larger software changes beyond its current Apple Intelligence roadmap.

The timing is also interesting because iOS 28 is expected to debut alongside Apple’s redesigned 20th-anniversary iPhone. Major iPhone redesigns have often been accompanied by software experiences built around new hardware capabilities, which may explain why Apple is reportedly placing greater importance on the update internally.

iOS 27 will focus heavily on Siri and Apple Intelligence

While iOS 28 remains a mystery, iOS 27 is expected to focus largely on upgrades to Siri and Apple Intelligence.

Apple is reportedly working on a more personalized Siri experience with on-screen awareness and better context understanding across apps like Mail and Messages.

The update is also expected to introduce:

  • A dedicated Siri app for back-and-forth conversations
  • Improved natural language understanding
  • A new “Search or Ask” experience in the Dynamic Island

Many of the features expected in iOS 27 were originally previewed earlier but were delayed before launch. As a result, iOS 27 is expected to focus more on delivering previously announced Apple Intelligence features rather than introducing an entirely new direction for the platform.

These additions are expected to make Siri feel more conversational and more aware of what users are doing across apps.

Apple will officially unveil iOS 27 during WWDC 2026 on June 8, while iOS 28 will likely be introduced at WWDC 2027. Until then, Apple’s plans for iOS 28 remain largely unknown beyond Gurman’s suggestion that it could be a far more ambitious release.

Do you expect iOS 28 to bring a major redesign? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

Update: Verified the latest NBA 2K26 Locker Codes on August 03, 2026

If you play NBA 2K26 regularly, you already know how slow progress can feel without packs, boosts, or VC. That’s where locker codes come in. They are the easiest way to get free rewards without grinding for hours or spending money. The catch is simple: they don’t last long, and if you miss them, they’re gone.

All active NBA 2k26 locker codes

  • WNBA-COMMISSIONERS-CUP: WNBA Invincible Player Option Pack (NEW)

That’s the only active code at the moment, but new ones can drop anytime. 2K releases them randomly, so the list can change quickly.

Expired NBA 2K26 locker codes

NBA-2K27-COVER-ATHLETES, HALI-GAME-1, FREE-BOOSTS, 2K-26-CREATOR-CHALLENGE, 2K26-MYTEAM-GAME-CHANGERS, ALL-STAR-NO-LIMIT, ALL-STAR-PACK-MT, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-0383-0877, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-3178-4640, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-5128-2959, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-60576581, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-6110-5004, BALL-OVER-EVERYTHING-8485-8260, BAM-83-POINTS, BEASTS-IN-MT-2K26, BOUNCE-MT-2K26, DELUXE-PACK-BALL-DROP, DROSE-AND-JERSEYS-SHOES, FLAGG-CURRY-MYTEAM, FOX-AND-SGA-IN-MT, FREE-WIN-IN-MYTEAM, HAPPY-HOLIDAYS-FROM-MYTEAM, MLK-DAY-MYTEAM, MT-CERTIFIED-2K26, MT-CHILLS-WILD-GEMS, MT-EDWARDS-AND-JOKIC, MT-HALLOWEEN, MT-HOLIDAY-BANNER, MT-LIN-DM-EVENT-CARD-LNY, MT-MITCHELL-BRUNSON, MT-PINK-DIAMOND-JALEN-JOHNSON, MT-ST-PATRICKS, MT-SWIFT-DROP, MT-THANKSGIVING, MYCAREER-MLK-DAY-2026, MYTEAM-ALUMNI, MYTEAM-KD-DONCIC, NBA-PIONEERS, NBA-TIP-OFF-IN-MYTEAM, PD-EVENT-CARD-VALENTINE, WNBA-IN-MYTEAM

How to redeem NBA 2K26 locker codes

Redeeming codes is simple, but if you’ve never done it before, it can feel slightly hidden inside menus. Here’s exactly what to do.

  1. Open NBA 2K26
  2. Go to MyTeam mode.
  3. Navigate to the Market tab.
  4. Scroll to Locker Codes.
  5. Enter the code exactly (including dashes).
  6. Press Done and claim your reward.
    • Image Credit: 2K Games

Once redeemed, the rewards are added instantly to your account.

What you get from locker codes

Locker codes are not just small bonuses. Sometimes they can completely change your progress. You can get:

  • Free VC
  • MyTeam player cards (including high-rated players)
  • Packs
  • MyPlayer clothing and gear
  • Skill and Gatorade boosts
  • XP boosts
  • Coach items and cosmetics

Some drops are minor, like boosts, but others can give you strong players early and save hours of grinding.

How to get more NBA 2K26 locker codes

This is where most players struggle. Codes don’t come from one place — they are scattered across multiple platforms.

2K usually releases them on:

  • Official NBA 2K MyTeam X (Twitter) account
  • TikTok
  • Community Discord server
  • NBA and WNBA broadcasts

Keeping track manually is messy. The easiest approach is to bookmark this page and check it often. We update it as soon as new codes arrive, so you don’t miss short-lived drops.

Why your NBA 2K26 locker code is not working

If a code fails, it’s usually one of these common issues.

  • The code has expired
  • You entered it incorrectly (especially missing dashes)
  • You already redeemed it before

If everything looks correct and it still doesn’t work, your last option is contacting 2K support.

What is a locker code?

A locker code is a limited-time text code released by 2K that you can enter inside the game to claim free rewards. These are usually tied to events, promotions, or seasonal drops.

The key detail is timing. Most codes stay active for only a few days to a week, which is why staying updated matters more than anything else.

Final thoughts

Locker codes in NBA 2K26 are one of those small things that make a big difference. You don’t feel it instantly, but over time, the free boosts, packs, and players stack up and give you a real advantage.

Right now, the list is short, but that’s normal. Codes come and go quickly. The players who benefit the most are the ones who check often and redeem fast.

If you don’t want to miss future drops, keep this page bookmarked and check back regularly — new codes can appear at any time.

Update: Verified the latest Black Grimoire Codes on August 02, 2026

If you’ve just jumped into Black Grimoire, you’ll quickly realize one thing. Progress can feel slow at the start. You need better stats, stronger abilities, and enough resources to actually compete. That’s exactly where codes come in.

These codes give you a clean head start. Free yules, boosts, tickets, and items that normally take time to grind. Instead of struggling early on, you get momentum right away.

All Working Black Grimoire Codes

  • ULTAMAYT: 500k yules and double yules for 15 minutes
  • JUICE: one moguro leaf juice
  • GUIZERAYT: double master for 15 minutes

These rewards are not small. Yules help you progress faster, while boosts like double mastery and double yules speed up everything you do. Tickets and removes let you fix bad rolls, which is huge in a game where your race and class matter a lot.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Unbox Your Car Codes, Unbox a Factory Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Black Grimoire Codes

mad, 1 yule, stats gone, airplane drifting, 15KLIKES, 1MVISITS, 2025CHRISTMASTRAITS, 20KLIKESOWO!!!, 30KLIKESZZ!, BIGUPDATE, BROS A SLIME, CANDYBOW2025, CANDYGRIMOIRE2025, CANDYSHIELD2025, CANDYSPEAR2025, CANDYSWORD2025, CAR, FREE TRAITS 123, MEREOLEONA, R, SOLMARRON, WHATS THE CODE, WHERES MY CLASSSS, WHERES MY RACEEEE, YAGAMI

How to Redeem Black Grimoire Codes

Before you can redeem codes, you need to join the NikkiDZN Roblox community. Without that, the system will not accept your codes.

Once that’s done, follow this:

  1. Launch Black Grimoire on Roblox.
  2. Press the M key or tap the menu button.
  3. Find the code input box
  4. Enter the code exactly.
  5. Press Enter to claim rewards.

The process is simple, but small mistakes like wrong spelling will stop the code from working.

What Black Grimoire Codes Actually Do

These codes are more than just freebies. They directly impact how fast you grow in the game.

You get yules to buy upgrades, boosts to level skills faster, and tickets to reroll your setup. If you get stuck with a weak race or class, these rewards give you another shot without restarting everything.

That’s why players keep coming back for new codes. They remove early frustration and let you focus on actually playing the game.

How to Get More Black Grimoire Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, milestones, or special events. The problem is, they are not announced clearly every time.

The easiest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. We keep it updated with the latest working codes so you don’t miss anything.

If you want to track them directly, you can:

  • Join the NikkiDZN Roblox group
  • Check the developer’s Discord server

Codes can appear anytime, so staying updated matters.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code is not working, there are only a few real reasons.

  • The code is expired
  • You entered it incorrectly
  • You already used it
  • The server is overloaded during an update

Copy and paste is the safest way to avoid mistakes. If servers are busy, just rejoin and try again.

What Makes Black Grimoire Worth Playing

Black Grimoire is not just another Roblox anime game. It blends exploration, PvP, and dungeon grinding in a way that actually keeps you engaged.

You are not just collecting items. You are building a character. Your race, class, and traits shape how you fight and progress. That makes every decision matter.

Codes simply remove the slow start. Once you use them, the game opens up faster, and you can focus on what actually makes it fun.

If you plan to stick with the game, keep checking for new codes. They are the easiest way to stay ahead without extra grind.

Update: Verified the latest Unbox Your Car Codes on August 03, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes in Unbox Your Car, you already know how the loop works. You open crates, get cars, earn cash, and slowly build a garage that actually feels yours. The grind is simple, but it can get slow. That is exactly where codes come in.

These Unbox Your Car codes give you free cash, enchanted crates, and even temporary boosts. In a game where progression depends on how many crates you can open, these rewards directly push you forward without waiting.

All Working Unbox Your Car Codes

  • ThanksPlain: Get 3 Enchanted Crates (NEW)
  • 1KLIKES: Get 200 Cash
  • 100LIKES: Get 200 Cash
  • welcome: Get 200 Cash

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest MotoRush Codes, Uma Racing Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Unbox Your Car Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

What These Rewards Actually Do

These rewards are not just small bonuses. They directly affect how fast you progress in the game.

  • Cash helps you buy more crates, which means more chances at better cars.
  • Enchanted Crates give higher-value cars compared to normal crates, making them one of the best rewards you can get early.
  • Cash Potion II temporarily increases how much cash you earn, letting you stack progress faster in a short time.

If you use all codes together, you get a strong early boost without grinding for hours.

How to Redeem Unbox Your Car Codes

Redeeming codes is simple, but missing one step or typing incorrectly can cause issues. Follow this exactly:

  1. Open Unbox Your Car on Roblox.
  2. Look at the bottom-right corner and click the Settings icon.
  3. Inside the menu, find and open the Codes section.
  4. Enter a code exactly as shown (codes are case sensitive).
  5. Click the Claim button.

If the code works, your rewards are added instantly.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code does not work, it is usually because of one of these reasons:

  • You entered the code incorrectly (capital letters matter).
  • The code has expired.
  • You are in an older server session.
  • There is a temporary network issue.

To avoid mistakes, copy and paste the code directly. If it still fails, the code is likely no longer active.

How New Codes Are Released

New codes in Unbox Your Car usually appear during updates or when the game hits milestones like likes or visits. That means there is no fixed schedule.

You can follow the game’s official Discord or community for updates, but realistically, the simplest method is to keep checking a reliable list.

Bookmark this page and check back regularly. That way, you always have the latest working codes without searching every time.

Final Thought

Unbox Your Car is designed to feel slow and rewarding, but codes give you a shortcut when you need it. A few crates and extra cash can completely change your early progress.

Use all the active codes now, and you will feel the difference immediately the next time you open a crate.

  • NBA 2K26 Locker Codes
  • Black Grimoire Codes

Update: Verified the latest Go Catch Codes on June 01, 2026

Getting stuck in a prehistoric world sounds exciting at first, until you realize you have to survive among dinosaurs with limited resources. That is exactly where Go Catch puts you. You play as a stranded scientist trying to fix a broken time machine, and every small boost matters. That is why these codes are worth grabbing early.

They give you coins that can speed things up, whether it is unlocking better tools, rerolling classes, or getting closer to stronger dinosaurs.

All Active Go Catch Codes

None

These rewards might look small at first, but early in the game, they make a noticeable difference. You can skip some of the grind and focus more on exploring and catching creatures.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Titan Fishing Codes, Survive the Apocalypse codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Go Catch Codes

100KTHANK, COOLCODEE, HACKER404, SORRYDELAY, UPDATE4, UPDATE6

How to Redeem Go Catch Codes

Before redeeming codes, you need to join the game’s official Roblox group. Without that, the codes will not work.

Follow these steps:

  1. Join the official Go Catch Roblox group.
  2. Launch Go Catch on Roblox.
  3. Click the Gift icon on the left side of the screen.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Click Submit to claim your rewards.

The process is simple, and once you do it once, it becomes second nature.

How to Get More Go Catch Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, especially when new content like the Ocean update is released. The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page, as we keep it refreshed with the latest working codes.

If you want to track them yourself, you can also:

  • Join the Go Catch Discord server and check the Codes channel
  • Follow the official Roblox group

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code is not working, it is usually due to a small issue rather than the code itself.

  • The code may have expired
  • You might not have joined the Roblox group
  • There could be a server issue
  • The code may be entered incorrectly

To fix this, try rejoining the game on a fresh server and copy-paste the code directly to avoid mistakes.

What Is Roblox Go Catch?

Go Catch is a prehistoric survival game where you play as a stranded scientist trying to repair a broken time machine.

You explore, collect ores, and catch dinosaurs using tools like pickaxes and dino balls, then use those resources to upgrade gear and progress faster.

Codes give you extra coins for class rerolls, weapon blueprints, and dino eggs, helping you skip early grind and focus on progression.

Final Thoughts

Go Catch starts simple but slowly builds into a rewarding loop of exploring, collecting, and upgrading. Codes help you skip some of the early grind and make the experience smoother, especially when you are just getting started.

Keep checking back for new codes, as updates often bring fresh rewards that can give you a solid advantage.

In case you missed:

  • Unbox a Factory Code
  • Be a Lucky Block Codes
  • Bizarre Lineage codes

Update: Verified the latest Garden Horizons Codes on June 29, 2026

Starting in Garden Horizons can feel slow. You begin with a small patch of land, basic seeds, and limited Shillings. Every upgrade takes time, and early progress depends heavily on how efficiently you plant, harvest, and reinvest. That is exactly why redeeming the latest Garden Horizons codes matters.

These codes give you free Shillings, seed packs, sprinklers, and exclusive items that would normally require hours of farming. If you want faster expansion, stronger mutation chances, and better automation early on, claim them immediately.

All Working Garden Horizons Codes

  • WEAREBACK: 2x Royal Seed Pack, Super Sprinkler, and 50k money (NEW)

Developers can disable codes at any time, so redeem them as soon as possible.

For more in-game rewards, be sure to check our Anime Eternal codes, SpongeBob Tower Defense codes, and Solo Hunters codes guides.

Expired Garden Horizons Codes

MONSTER, 358, ADMIN, CONSOLE, DAWN, DAWNFRUIT, GIFT, RELEASE, THANKYOU

How to Redeem Garden Horizons Codes

Redeeming codes is straightforward:

  1. Launch Garden Horizons in Roblox.
  2. Click the Cogwheel icon in the top-left corner.
  3. Scroll down to the Codes text box in Settings.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Press the arrow button to claim rewards.

Rewards are applied instantly if the code is valid.

Why a Code Might Not Work

If a code fails, check the following:

  • The code was typed incorrectly. They are case-sensitive.
  • The code has expired.
  • You already redeemed it.
  • You are not part of the required Roblox group for group-exclusive codes such as DAWN and DAWNFRUIT.
  • Roblox servers have been unstable following a recent update.

For group-exclusive rewards, join the official Dawn Digital Roblox group, restart the game, and try again.

Check the All Roblox Game Codes Master List to find working codes for every game.

When New Garden Horizons Codes Are Released

New codes usually drop during:

  • Major updates and patches
  • Player milestone celebrations
  • Seasonal events

Developers typically share them through their official Discord server and X account, especially in the dedicated codes channel. You can also bookmark this page. We will update the codes as soon as new codes drop. 

Fastest Way to Earn More Shillings

Codes provide a boost, but efficient gameplay sustains growth. Check the quest billboard near the shops for daily and weekly tasks. These quests reward bonus Shillings and seed packs and are often more profitable than passive harvesting alone.

Reinvest profits into higher-tier seeds instead of repeatedly planting low-value crops. Focus on crops with strong mutation potential and scale automation with sprinklers to increase output per cycle.

What Garden Horizons Is About

Garden Horizons is a Roblox farming simulator developed by Dawn Digital. You start with a basic plot, buy seeds from the shop, plant them, wait for them to grow, and sell your harvest for Shillings. Those Shillings fund better seeds, sprinklers, decorations, and land expansions.

The depth comes from its mutation system and weather mechanics. Certain crops can mutate into rarer, higher-value variants. Completing your flora diary, finishing quests, and climbing leaderboards adds long-term goals beyond simple harvesting. While it takes inspiration from Grow a Garden, it builds on the formula with more layered progression and competitive elements.

Why Codes Are Important Early Game

Progress in the first few hours is limited by how quickly you can generate Shillings. Basic seeds provide modest returns, and growth cycles take time. Codes eliminate that bottleneck.

With rewards like 50k Shillings or premium seed packs, you can:

  • Purchase high-value seeds immediately
  • Unlock sprinklers to automate crop growth
  • Increase chances of valuable mutations
  • Expand your land sooner
  • Invest in stronger long-term setups

Instead of grinding low-tier crops, you move directly into mid-game progression.

Do Garden Horizons Codes Expire?

Yes. All codes are time-limited and can be removed without notice. If a new code appears, redeem it immediately.

Using codes strategically gives you early control over your garden’s growth curve. Instead of slowly building from basic crops, you can establish a strong foundation, unlock better seeds faster, and push toward rare mutations and leaderboard progression much earlier.

Tap Simulator is one of those Roblox games that looks simple at first but quickly turns into a satisfying grind. As you progress, you unlock new islands, collect stronger pets, and climb leaderboards.

How to Redeem Tap Simulator Codes

Redeeming codes in Tap Simulator only takes a few seconds once you know where to look.

  1. Open Tap Simulator on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings (cog icon) in the top‑left corner.
  3. Select the Codes button.
  4. Enter your code in the input field.
  5. Press Redeem to claim the reward.

If the code is valid, the reward will be added to your account instantly.

What Tap Simulator Is About

Tap Simulator is a classic Roblox clicker game built around constant progression. Players tap to generate clicks, which act as the main currency in the game.

Clicks are used to hatch eggs that contain pets. Each pet increases your clicking strength, allowing you to earn more clicks faster. With stronger pets, players can unlock new worlds, perform rebirths, and access additional upgrades.

Some pets can even be turned into stronger variants, such as golden pets, which provide even larger boosts. Over time, the game becomes less about tapping manually and more about building the strongest pet lineup possible.

How To Get More Tap Simulator Codes

New Tap Simulator codes usually appear during major game updates, special events, or when the game hits player milestones. Developers often release them through official community channels.

If you want to find new codes yourself, check the following places:

  • The official Tap Simulator Discord server.

  • The developers’ social media accounts.

You can also bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update the list whenever new Tap Simulator codes are released, so you never miss free rewards.

Why Tap Simulator Codes May Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail to redeem even if it appears correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons.

  1. Typing mistakes – Codes must be entered exactly as written, including capital letters.
  2. Expired codes – Developers often disable codes after a certain period.
  3. Server delays – Newly released codes may take time to activate across all servers.

Copying and pasting the code directly is usually the safest way to avoid errors.

When New Tap Simulator Codes Are Released

  • Seasonal celebrations

Update: Verified the latest Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes on August 03, 2026

If you are trying to get stronger in Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental, you will quickly realize that progress depends heavily on your rolls. Every better Trait, stronger Cursed Technique, or improved stat build comes down to how many chances you get. That is exactly where codes come in, giving you extra rolls and helping you grow faster without grinding endlessly.

Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental is a progression-based Roblox experience inspired by the anime. You train your sorcerer, fight curses, and slowly build power over time. The game even runs with idle mechanics, so you can keep improving while doing other things. But to truly stand out and reach higher grades, you need strong roles, and codes make that journey much easier.

All Working Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

  • IMASTRIKER: 100 Style Rolls (NEW)
  • WEATHER: 30 All Rolls (NEW)
  • TITLES: 15 All Rolls (NEW)
  • TENSURA: 15 All Rolls and 1 Companion Roll (NEW)
  • 1KREACTSBAKA: (NEW) 500 CT Rolls, 500 Style Rolls, 25 Trait Rolls, 25 Clan Rolls, and 5 Companion Rolls
  • HTHV2: Resets technique
  • ABSOLUTE: 125 CT Rerolls
  • HEAVENLY: 15 All Rolls
  • CE: 5000 Yen, 2000 XP, and 10 All Rolls
  • SORRYFORDELAY: Free Rewards
  • HTH: 100 CT Rerolls, 100 Trait Rerolls, 100 Style Rerolls, 100 Clan Rerolls, 25 Companion Rerolls, 250,000 Yen, and 50,000 XP
  • CONTRACTS: Free Rewards

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Jujutsu Infinite Codes, Anime Ascendants Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

1000ROLLS, 100KVISITS, 1KPLAYERS, 1MVISITS, ARTCONTEST, BOOGIE, CLANWARS, CLOZYGOAT, CT, CULLINGGAMES, CULLINGGAMESP2, DELAYKAISENINCREMENTAL, EASTER, FEMBOYS, FINEHEREIGG, HEYLOL, ILOVEYOU, JJK3D, LIKEREWARD, MEOW, MINIUPDATE, MODULOSOON, OVERLORDOFTHECENTURY, PATREON, QUALITYMOG, RAIDSUPDATE, REINCARNATE, ROLLBACK, SHINJUKU2, SHINJUKUPT1, SORRY, SORRY4DELAY, SORRYGUYS, STILLINLOVE, THANKYOU, THEJJKISITUATIONISCRAZY, WDITTO, YANDERE, ZERO

How to Redeem Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

Before redeeming codes, you must join the Real Mouse Productions Roblox group. Without this step, the game will not allow you to claim rewards.

Once that is done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button at the top right of the screen.
  3. Find the Enter Code Here section.
  4. Paste your code into the box.
  5. Click Redeem to get your rewards instantly.

Make sure you enter codes exactly as shown. They are case-sensitive, so even a small mistake can prevent them from working.

Why Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes Are Important

In this game, almost everything depends on your rolls. Your damage output, abilities, and overall potential are tied to what you unlock. That means more rolls directly translates into better builds.

Instead of waiting for slow progression, codes give you a shortcut. They help you reroll faster, chase rare traits, and build a stronger sorcerer without wasting time. If you want to reach higher ranks like Grade 1, using codes regularly is almost necessary.

How to Get More Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes

New codes are usually released during updates, milestones, or special events. The developers also share them through their Discord server and community pages, but finding them there can be confusing since codes for multiple games are often posted together.

The easiest way is to bookmark our page. We keep this list updated with the latest working codes, so you can always find them in one place without searching.

Why Your Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Code Is Not Working

If a code is not working, there are a few common reasons:

  • You have not joined the required Roblox group
  • The code is typed incorrectly or is missing capital letters
  • The code has expired
  • The code may only work in newer servers, so try rejoining

If a new code does not work immediately, wait a bit and try again, as some codes take time to activate across servers.

What Is Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental on Roblox?

Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental is a mix of simulation, idle progression, and turn-based combat. You train your character, fight enemies, and unlock stronger abilities over time. The game rewards patience, but also gives you tools like codes to speed things up.

You can:

  • Train to improve stats like strength, defense, and speed
  • Fight curses to earn rewards and experience
  • Roll for Traits and Cursed Techniques to shape your build
  • Progress even while AFK thanks to idle mechanics

There is also an official Trello that acts like a guidebook, helping you understand abilities, items, and strategies as you grow stronger.

In the end, the game is all about building your own path as a sorcerer. Codes simply make that path smoother, faster, and a lot more exciting.

In case you missed:

  • Go Catch Codes
  • Diesel n Steel Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes

Update: Verified the latest Chasing Immortality Codes on June 01, 2026

Starting out in Chasing Immortality feels slow. You begin as someone with nothing, growing step by step through life stages, trying to survive, train, and eventually reach power that actually matters. That’s exactly where codes help-they don’t break the game, but they remove the early grind and make every rebirth feel worth it.

Here are all the latest working Chasing Immortality codes you can use right now.

All Active Chasing Immortality Codes

  • DELAYS: 1 Heavens Pill (NEW)
  • FINALDEMONIC: 100 Souls Fragments (NEW)
  • NOWAYUPDATE: 250 Souls Fragments (NEW)

These can disappear anytime, so it’s better to redeem them immediately.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Ghoul Incremental Codes, Knockout Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Chasing Immortality Codes

9KLIKES, DEMONIC, LIKETHEGAME2, OPENTEST1, PRAY, RELEASE, SHORTUPDATE, TYFORSUPPORT, UPDATE3, WELOVEKIRIVA, WOWUPDATE

How to Redeem Chasing Immortality Codes

Before you redeem anything, there’s one requirement you cannot skip-you must join the official Roblox group and like the game. Once that’s done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Chasing Immortality on Roblox.
  2. Select Save File 1.
  3. Open the Misc menu at the top.
  4. Go to the Codes tab.
  5. Enter your code.
  6. Click Submit to claim rewards.

If everything is done correctly, your rewards will be added instantly.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it’s usually something small rather than the code itself.

  • You didn’t join the Roblox group or like the game
  • Typing error in the code (copy-paste is safer)
  • Temporary server issues
  • Unstable internet connection

If the code still doesn’t work, rejoin the game or try again after a few minutes.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually drop without warning, so timing matters.

  • Roblox group (required anyway for redemption)
  • Official Discord server
  • Game update announcements

The easiest way is to bookmark this page and follow along, so you never miss new code drops.

Why These Codes Matter

Chasing Immortality is built around rebirth. Every time you restart, you carry forward progress through Soul Fragments. These are not just basic rewards-they permanently improve your stats, luck, cooldowns, and overall efficiency.

In simple terms, codes speed up your entire progression loop. Instead of grinding multiple lifetimes for small gains, you get a head start that compounds over time.

Along with fragments, you may also get items like Heavens Pills. These can boost things like lifespan or Qi, depending on the type, making your current run stronger and more stable.

Final Thoughts

Chasing Immortality is not about rushing-it’s about steady growth across multiple lives. But without a little boost early on, it can feel slow and repetitive.

These codes fix that. They give you just enough momentum to make each rebirth meaningful, without removing the satisfaction of progress.

Use them early, stack your fragments, and your future runs will feel completely different.

In case you missed:

  • NBA 2K26 Locker Codes
  • Black Grimoire Codes
  • Unbox Your Car Codes

Update: Verified the latest Ghoul Incremental Codes on June 01, 2026

If you have spent even a little time in Ghoul Incremental, you already know how slow things can feel at the start. You grind, you wait, and just when things start picking up, you hit a wall. That is exactly where codes come in. They give you that small but crucial push that turns a slow run into real progress.

Instead of hoping for better stats or wasting time rerolling blindly, you can use these codes to get free rerolls for your Kagune, combat style, and multipliers. That means better builds, faster growth, and a much smoother climb toward becoming a powerful ghoul.

All Working Ghoul Incremental Codes

  • LIKES1K: 4 Kagune Rolls, 4 Combat Style Rolls, 4 RG Multiplier Rolls (NEW)
  • PVP: 2 Kagune Rolls, 2 Combat Style Rolls, 2 RG Multiplier Rolls (NEW)
  • RAIDS: 4 Kagune Rolls, 4 Combat Style Rolls, 4 RG Multiplier Rolls
  • SORRYFORBUGS: 1 Kagune Rolls, 1 Combat Style Rolls, 1 RG Multiplier Rolls
  • IMAGHOUL: 1 Kagune Rolls, 1 Combat Style Rolls, 1 RG Multiplier Rolls

These rewards might look small, but in an incremental game, even a single good reroll can completely change your run.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Unbox a Factory Codes, Reign Piece Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Ghoul Incremental Codes

FASTLIKES, LIKES150, LIKES500

How to Redeem Ghoul Incremental Codes

Redeeming codes in Ghoul Incremental is simple and takes just a few seconds.

  1. Open Ghoul Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Click the Gift icon on the screen.
  3. Paste a working code into the text box.
  4. Click Redeem.

If the code is valid, you will instantly receive your rewards.

Why These Codes Matter

Ghoul Incremental is not just about clicking and waiting. It is about smart progression. You collect Blood, unlock upgrades, and eventually hit a point where progress slows down heavily. That is when systems like rerolls and multipliers become important.

  • Kagune Rolls help you get stronger abilities
  • Combat Style Rolls improve how you fight
  • RG Multipliers boost your overall growth speed

Using codes at the right time can save hours of grinding and help you push past difficult stages.

Understanding Progression in Ghoul Incremental

At its core, the game is a classic incremental experience inspired by Tokyo Ghoul. You collect Blood, spend it on upgrades, and repeat the cycle. Eventually, you will reach a point where progress slows down significantly. This is where the prestige system comes in.

  • You reset your progress
  • You earn RC Cells
  • You unlock permanent upgrades

These upgrades stay with you even after future resets, making each run faster than the last.

As you go deeper, you also unlock Automation, which lets the game handle upgrades for you. This is essential for idle play and makes repeated runs much easier.

Common Issues When Codes Do Not Work

If a code is not working, it is usually not a bug. Most of the time, it is one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired
  • You entered the code incorrectly
  • Your server is outdated
  • Your internet connection is unstable

The easiest fix is to copy and paste the code directly and, if needed, rejoin a new server.

How to Get More Ghoul Incremental Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to keep checking a reliable list instead of searching manually. You can also:

  • Join the official Discord server
  • Follow the Roblox community page

Update: Verified the latest Unbox a Factory Codes on August 03, 2026

Starting in Unbox a Factory feels simple at first. You open a crate, place a factory, and watch the cash roll in. But very quickly, you realize progress slows down unless you scale smart. That is where codes step in. They give you a small but meaningful push that helps you move faster without waiting.

These codes are not just freebies. They directly impact how quickly you grow your factory network, unlock upgrades, and reach automation.

All Active Unbox a Factory Codes

  • ThanksPlain: 3 Enchanted Crate (NEW)
  • Welcome: 200 Cash and 1 Cash Potion 2 (NEW)
  • 100likes: 200 Cash (NEW)
  • 1klikes: 200 Cash (NEW)

Rewards may slightly vary depending on updates, but all of them help you progress faster by giving instant resources.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Sailor Piece Codes, Be a Lucky Block Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Unbox a Factory Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Unbox a Factory Codes

Redeeming codes is quick and does not interrupt your gameplay. You can do it in seconds once you know where to look.

  1. Open Unbox a Factory in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings or cogwheel icon in the bottom right.
  3. Find and open the Codes section.
  4. Enter your code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

If a code does not work, double check spelling or try copying and pasting instead of typing.

What Unbox a Factory Is Actually About

Unbox a Factory takes a simple idea and stretches it into a satisfying loop. You open crates, get factories, and place them on your plot. Each factory generates cash over time, even when you are offline.

Visitors come in, money builds up, and you slowly expand. As you progress, you unlock better crates, stronger factories, and systems that reduce manual work.

Why Codes Matter More Than You Think

At the start, everything feels fast. But once you reach mid-game, upgrades cost more and progress slows down. This is where codes help.

They give you:

  • Extra cash to open more crates instantly
  • Potions that boost your earnings
  • Better crates that improve your factory quality

That small boost can save hours of waiting. It helps you move from manual collecting to automation much quicker.

Automation, Workers, and Scaling Faster

The real goal is not just placing factories. It is building a system that runs itself. You can unlock features like:

  • Workers that automate your factories
  • Automatic dispensers that streamline production
  • Upgrades that increase output over time

Codes help you reach this stage earlier, which is where the game becomes more satisfying.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually drop when the game hits milestones like likes or updates. The easiest way to stay updated is to keep checking pages like this one. You can also:

  • Join the official Habit Games Roblox group
  • Join their Discord server

Still, the fastest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes go live.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work?

If your code is not working, it usually comes down to two things.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or incorrect capitalization

Always enter codes exactly as shown. Even small mistakes can cause them to fail.

Final Thought

Unbox a Factory is about turning a single crate into a full system that prints money while you do nothing. Codes simply speed up that journey. Use them early, use them fast, and focus on building a setup that can run on its own. That is where the game really starts to feel rewarding.

Explore More

  • Chasing Immortality Codes
  • Unbox a Factory Code
  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

Update: Verified the latest Be a Lucky Block Codes on August 03, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes in Be a Lucky Block, you already know one thing. luck decides everything. One second you are just another block, the next you pull a rare Brainrot and suddenly your income shoots up. That’s exactly where codes come in. They give you a small push, but in a game built on RNG, that push matters more than it should.

Below is the latest list of working Be a Lucky Block codes, along with how to redeem them and why they are actually worth using.

All Active Be a Lucky Block Codes

  • RADIOACTIVE: 150x Honeycomb (NEW)
  • BEE: 100x Honeycomb (NEW)
  • DinoByte: Free Coins (NEW)
  • CORALUKE: Free Rewards
  • BIRD: 30 Spins
  • M2ZF4KYR: 2x Secret Block
  • EASTER: 35x Free Coins
  • FIX31: 100x Easter Eggs
  • R81KM461: 2x Secret Block
  • GOD: Get a Free Brainrot
  • DEVIL: Get a Free Brainrot
  • ZEUS: Get an Angelzini Bananini
  • RELEASE: Get a Brr Brr Patapim

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Sailor Piece Codes, Type Soul Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Be a Lucky Block Codes

Currently, there are no expired codes in the game right now, so get in the game and redeem the active ones right now.

How to Redeem Be a Lucky Block Codes

Redeeming codes here is simple, and you only need a few clicks. The game keeps it straightforward.

  1. Launch Be a Lucky Block on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop icon on the side of the screen.
  3. Open the Codes tab.
  4. Paste the code into the text box.
  5. Click Verify to claim rewards.

If nothing happens, double-check spelling or try switching servers.

What Be a Lucky Block Is Actually About

At its core, Be a Lucky Block is an RNG simulator where you don’t control outcomes directly , you influence them.

You step onto a ramp, get turned into a lucky block, and the system places you into a base. Once opened, you transform into a random Brainrot. Some are common, some are absurdly rare, and the difference between them is your entire progression.

The goal is simple:

  • Get better Brainrots
  • Increase income per second
  • Upgrade into rarer blocks

But getting there is not simple at all. That’s where codes and strategy start to matter.

How to Get Secret Lucky Blocks

Secret blocks are the real endgame. They are rare, hard to get, and worth the grind.

You can get them through:

  • Luck rolls: Extremely low chance from normal openings
  • Red Carpet: Premium area with better spawn chances
  • Limited-time events: Mini-games like Escape Tsunami or Jailbreak
  • Trading: Swap items with other players

Codes sometimes help indirectly by improving your starting point, which increases your odds over time.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it is usually not the code itself.

  • Typo in the code (most common issue)
  • Server or network problems
  • Expired code (not the case right now)

Best way to avoid issues is to copy-paste directly and try again after rejoining.

How to Get More Be a Lucky Block Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, events, or milestones.

You can find them from:

  • Official Discord server
  • X (Twitter) account of the developers
  • YouTube channel updates

Bookmark this page and we will keep the codes updated so you do not have to hunt for them every time.

Should You Even Care About Codes?

Yes, especially early on. Be a Lucky Block is a game where progress is slow unless luck is on your side. Codes give you controlled luck. Not guaranteed wins, but enough of a boost to make a difference.

If you are playing seriously, skipping codes is just slowing yourself down for no reason.

Explore More

  • Chasing Immortality Codes
  • Unbox a Factory Code
  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

Update: Verified the latest Sailor Piece Codes on August 03, 2026

Sailor Piece is one of those Roblox games where progress feels great, but getting there takes time. You fight bandits, chase better builds, reroll stats, and slowly move toward stronger abilities. It is fun, but the grind is real. That is where codes come in. They give you free resources that would otherwise take hours to earn. If you are playing seriously, redeeming codes is part of the game, not an extra.

How To Redeem Sailor Piece Codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look. The option is slightly hidden in the settings menu, so most new players miss it at first.

Before you redeem, keep this in mind: many codes in Sailor Piece have level requirements. Some work early, but many are locked behind high levels like 2,000, 6,000, or even 10,000. If a code does not work, you might just not be at the required level yet.

  1. Launch Sailor Piece on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon on the left side.
  3. Scroll down to the bottom of the menu.
  4. Enter your code in the “A Secret Code…” box.
  5. Click Redeem.

Your rewards are applied instantly.

What These Codes Actually Give You

At a glance, the rewards look like random items. But in Sailor Piece, almost everything ties back to progression.

  • Beli helps you buy weapons and items across islands
  • Gems unlock features and improve your chances at better abilities
  • Clan, race, and trait rerolls let you fix or optimize your build
  • Shards push your stats further
  • Chests and crates give extra resources and customization

This is why codes matter. They are not just freebies. They reduce bad RNG and save hours of grinding.

Why Your Codes Are Not Working

If a code fails, it usually comes down to a few common reasons.

  • The code has expired
  • You have not reached the required level yet
  • There is a typing mistake
  • You already used the code

Codes are case-sensitive, so copying them directly is the safest way.

Also, some codes may briefly work only in private servers before going live everywhere. Since private servers are free, it can be worth trying there.

When New Codes Are Released

Sailor Piece developers usually drop new codes during key moments in the game.

  • Major updates
  • Milestones like likes or visits
  • Server issues or restarts

Most of these are shared on the official Discord, but they are not always easy to track. Bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes drop.

What Sailor Piece Is About

Sailor Piece is a bandit-beater Roblox RPG inspired by One Piece. You level up by fighting enemies, unlocking fruits, and improving your build through rerolls and upgrades. The loop is simple. Fight, upgrade, repeat.

Codes just make that loop faster and less frustrating, especially once you start pushing into higher levels.

Update: Verified the latest Bizarre Lineage Codes on July 09, 2026

If you just started playing Bizarre Lineage, you will feel it immediately. The game throws you into fights, raids, and builds where small upgrades make a big difference. Getting stronger early is not just about grinding. It is about using every free boost you can get. That is exactly where these codes come in.

They give you useful items like Stand Stat Point Essences, which directly affect how your build performs. Whether you are still figuring out your first Stand or trying to fine-tune a stronger setup, these rewards save time and help you progress faster.

All working Bizarre Lineage codes

  • !code Delay1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Delay2: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Delay3: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Update1: Free Rewards
  • !code BizarreLineage1: Free Rewards
  • !code Update2=2027: Free Rewards
  • !code LikeTheGameForMore1: Free Rewards
  • !code FavoriteTheGame1: Free Rewards
  • !code 250kLikes: Free Rewards
  • !code 500kLikes: Free Rewards
  • !code 750LikesforNextCode: Free Rewards

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Clover Retribution Codes, Survive the Knockout Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Bizarre Lineage codes

!CODE 100KLIKES, !CODE 1WEEK, !CODE 30KLIKES, !CODE SHUTDOWNWOOPS

What these codes actually give you

Bizarre Lineage is built around your character’s build. Your Stand, your stats, and your sub abilities all work together. The items from the codes directly feed into this system.

Most of these codes give Stand Stat Point Essences. These let you adjust or improve your stats based on the build you are aiming for. If you choose the wrong stats early, your damage or survivability can fall off quickly. These rewards help fix that without needing to grind again.

Depending on future updates, codes can also include things like cash, chests, or stat resets. All of these are designed to reduce friction and help you experiment with different playstyles.

How to redeem Bizarre Lineage codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look.

  1. Open Bizarre Lineage on Roblox.
  2. Open the chat box in the game.
  3. Type the code exactly as shown.
  4. Press Enter to claim your rewards.

Some players miss this because there is no separate code menu. Everything happens directly through chat.

In some cases, you may also need to like the game or join the community group before codes work properly.

Why your code might not work

If a code does not work, it is usually something small.

  • The game just updated and servers need a moment to stabilize
  • The code was typed incorrectly or has wrong casing
  • The code expired
  • You have not joined the required Roblox group

Copy and paste is the easiest way to avoid mistakes. If it still fails, restarting Roblox usually fixes temporary issues.

How to get more Bizarre Lineage codes

Codes usually drop through the official Discord server, especially in announcement channels. The problem is that they are easy to miss.

Most players end up spending more time searching for codes than actually playing. Bookmark our page and we will keep the codes updated with the latest ones, so you never miss new drops.

What Bizarre Lineage is and why codes matter

Bizarre Lineage is a Roblox RPG inspired by JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure. You build your character, unlock Stand abilities, and fight through PvE and PvP content.

The game also includes sub abilities like Hamon, Cyborg, Vampire, and Spin. Each one changes how your character plays. Some focus on raw strength, while others give you ranged or healing advantages.

Because the game is heavily build based, small stat changes matter more than they seem. That is why these codes are useful. They are not just freebies. They directly impact how your character performs in fights and raids.

If you are starting out, these codes give you a cleaner path. If you are already progressing, they give you room to experiment without wasting resources.

That is what makes them worth using every time new ones drop.

In case you missed:

  • Sailor Piece Codes
  • Be a Lucky Block Codes
  • Go Catch Codes
  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

Update: Verified the latest Sorcerer Incremental Codes on August 03, 2026

If you have been playing Sorcerer Incremental for even a short time, you already know how grind-heavy the game can feel. You keep clicking, rolling, and progressing slowly, hoping to unlock something powerful. That is exactly where codes step inthey give you a shortcut, a small push that makes the journey smoother and a lot more fun.

In a game built around repetition and steady growth, even a few extra rolls or resources can completely change your progress. So if you are serious about getting stronger faster, these codes are not optional; they are essential.

All Active Sorcerer Incremental Codes

  • BUGFIX: (NEW) 200x Technique Roll, 3x Sukuna’s Finger, 40x Energy Scroll, 40x Clan Scroll, 150x Weapon Roll
  • BALANCE: (NEW) 125x Technique Roll, 2x Sukuna’s Finger, 35x Energy Scroll, 40x Clan Scroll, 100x Weapon Roll
  • AP: (NEW) 75x Technique Roll, 1x Sukuna’s Finger, 30x Energy Scroll, 30x Clan Scroll, 75x Weapon Roll

Each of these codes usually gives you a mix of useful resources like technique rolls, clan rolls, weapon rolls, ally rolls, energy scrolls, and sometimes even rare items like Sukuna Fingers. These are all things you would otherwise need to grind for.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Evil Plate Game Codes, Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Sorcerer Incremental Codes

2000LIKES, 3000LIKES, 4000LIKES, 5500LIKES, ADAPTATION, BIGRAGA, BINDINGVOWS, BOUNDLESSCE, CALAMITY, CALAMITYYUTA, CLANTREE, COMEDIAN, COPYMASTERED, DELAY, DELAYOOPS, DELAYYY, DOMAIN, EASTERBUNNY, EGGHUNT, EVOLUTION, FIXEDGAME, GANGBOSS, GANGWARS, GULLIBLE, HEIANKUNA, HOMELESS, HONOREDONE, INVENTORYCURSE, KINGOFCURSES, LARPER, LIMITLESS, MAHORAGA, MASTERED, MEGADELAY, MEGADELAY1, MEGADELAY2, MEGADELAY3, MINIUPDATE, NEWERA, NEWGOJOHONORED, NEWHONORED, NEWMYTHICALNAOYA, POLYMATH, PRESTIGE, PROJECTIONHAX, QUEENOFCURSES, ROGUELIKE, SEASON3FINALE, SIXEYES, SORRYFORWAIT, SPRINGTIME, SRY4DELAY, STRATEGY, TENSHADOWS, THANKYOU, TOJIWORM, TRUEDOMAIN, TRUEMUTUALLOVE, YUGOAT, ZENINCLAN

How to Redeem Sorcerer Incremental Codes

Redeeming codes in Sorcerer Incremental is simple and takes just a few seconds. Before that, make sure you have joined the official Roblox group for the game, as some codes may not work without it.

  1. Open Sorcerer Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Codes button (usually at the top-right of the screen).
  3. Click on it to open the code menu.
  4. Enter your code exactly as shown.
  5. Press redeem and claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, your rewards will be added instantly. If not, double-check the spelling or try another code.

What Do These Codes Actually Give You?

This is where things get interesting. Sorcerer Incremental is built around rerolls and progression loops. You keep resetting, rolling, and improving your character step by step.

Codes directly feed into this system by giving you:

  • Technique Rolls: Unlock stronger abilities
  • Clan Rolls: Improve your base traits
  • Weapon Rolls: Get better combat tools
  • Ally Rolls: Strengthen your support system
  • Energy Scrolls: Boost progression speed
  • Sukuna Fingers: Rare and powerful upgrades

Instead of waiting hours to earn these, codes give them to you instantly. That is why using them early can make a huge difference in how fast you grow.

Why Codes Matter So Much in This Game

Sorcerer Incremental is not just about playing it is about optimizing. Every reset, every roll, every upgrade matters. Without extra resources, progress can feel slow and repetitive.

Codes act like a head start. They reduce the grind, help you experiment with builds, and make the game feel more rewarding instead of exhausting.

If you are someone who enjoys seeing progress quickly and trying different strategies, these codes are one of the best tools you have.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually show up during updates, milestones, and events, but there is no fixed timing. The safest way is to follow the official places where the developers actually post them.

  • Blumea Productions Roblox group (required for some codes to work)
  • Sorcerer Incremental Discord server (fastest updates)
  • Official Trello (useful for understanding weapons, techniques, and systems)

Codes can expire without notice, so checking these regularly helps. If you do not want to track everything yourself, just bookmark this page. We keep it updated and tested so you always have the latest working codes.

Final Thoughts

Sorcerer Incremental is designed to be a slow, steady climb. That is part of its charm, but it can also feel frustrating at times. Codes help balance that experience. They give you just enough boost to keep things exciting without breaking the game.

If you want to progress faster, unlock better abilities, and enjoy the game without unnecessary grind, make sure you use every active code available. It is one of the simplest ways to improve your experience instantly.

In case you missed:

  • Diesel n Steel Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes
  • Survive the Apocalypse codes
