Update: Verified the latest Mashle Academy Codes on June 01, 2026

Mashle Academy finally brings the world of Mashle: Magic and Muscles into Roblox, and it lands exactly how fans would expect. You are thrown into a world where magic decides everything, unless you are strong enough to break that rule. Getting stronger takes time, but codes give you a quick push when you need it most.

These Mashle Academy codes give you free rewards like gold, silver, magic rolls, and even rerolls. If you are trying to build a better loadout or recover from a bad start, these freebies make a real difference.

All Working Mashle Academy Codes

  • WEAPONSWAP: 240 Gold Coins (NEW)
  • FPSINPUTS: 240 Gold Coins
  • Subscribe_AttackOnDevs: Free Rewards

All codes are currently working, but that can change anytime. Roblox codes expire without warning, so it is better to redeem them as soon as possible.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Meta Lock Codes, My Dragon Island Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Mashle Academy Codes

AVATARBUGFIX, BLESS, CLEAR, COMPENSATION, DELAYEDUPDATE, DETENTIONRESTORE, EASTEREVENT, EIDMUBARAK, FIXAGAIN, FIXFIXFIX, ISSUES1, ISSUES2, NEWBUILD, NEWSTATS, PARTTWOLATER, PLAYGAMELEGIT, RANKEDCLIMB, RELEASE, STARTER, SUBSCRIBE_ARICKUU, SUBSCRIBE_DARIUSVIBEZ, SUBSCRIBE_ITSVAMPREX, SUBSCRIBE_PXLSWIFT, SUBSCRIBE_REVOLVERAGZ, SUBSCRIBE_UNIVERSALPANTHER, SUBSCRIBE_YODOMM, WAVE2, WEEKENDOVER

How to Redeem Mashle Academy Codes

Before redeeming codes, you need to complete the tutorial. This unlocks the core parts of the game and lets you access the NPC required for redemption.

Once that is done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Mashle Academy on Roblox.
  2. Go to the Academy Assistant NPC inside the dorms.
  3. Press E to interact.
  4. Enter a working code.
  5. Press Enter to claim rewards.

Rewards are applied instantly, so you can use them right away to improve your build.

Why Codes Matter in Mashle Academy

Mashle Academy is not just another anime RPG where you grind endlessly without direction. Your progress depends heavily on your magic, gear, and overall build. If your rolls are bad early on, it can slow everything down.

This is where codes help. They give you extra rolls, currency, and sometimes even reset options. That means you can fix mistakes, try new builds, or just move faster without wasting hours.

If you have ever felt stuck with a weak setup, these rewards are the easiest way out.

How to Get More Mashle Academy Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, bug fixes, or milestones. The developers also share them through official channels like Discord and Roblox groups. You can also check the developer’s Trello board.

However, tracking all of that manually is not practical. The easiest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. The list is updated whenever new codes are released and old ones stop working.

Why Your Mashle Academy Codes Are Not Working

If a code does not work, there are a few common reasons:

  • You are on an outdated server
  • The code has already been used on your account
  • There is a typo in the code

Mashle Academy codes are account-based. This means once you use a code, you cannot reuse it on another slot. If you switch characters, the rewards will not be available again.

If nothing works, try joining a new server and entering the code again.

What is Mashle Academy?

Mashle Academy is a Roblox RPG inspired by Mashle: Magic and Muscles. It blends magic systems with melee combat, letting you build your character around different playstyles.

You can learn magic, switch styles, fight enemies, and take on bosses while progressing through a competitive world where strength and strategy both matter.

Update: Verified the latest Survive the Apocalypse Codes on August 10, 2026

Survive the Apocalypse drops you into a world where every run feels like it could be your last. You start with almost nothing, surrounded by zombies, and everything depends on how well you explore, gather resources, and upgrade over time. That is where codes quietly make a real difference. They give you free Emeralds, and early on, that can completely change how long you last.

All Working Survive the Apocalypse codes

  • NEWCHAPTER2731: 25 Emeralds (NEW)
  • happy250: 25 Emeralds

Emeralds are one of the most important resources in the game. You use them to unlock classes, roll for upgrades, and improve your chances in later waves where enemies get harder and more aggressive.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Evil Plate Game Codes, Roblox Subterra Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired codes

outlaw627, hardmode62, survivor, release, apocalypseperks

How to redeem codes in Survive the Apocalypse

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look, but it is slightly hidden if you are new.

  1. Launch Survive the Apocalypse in Roblox.
  2. Click the Emeralds button on the left side.
  3. Press the Codes button in the menu.
  4. Enter a working code in the box.
  5. Click Claim to get your rewards.

If the code works, the Emeralds will be added instantly to your account.

Why your codes may not work

If a code is not working, it usually comes down to a few common reasons.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or incorrect capitalization
  • The game server has not synced after an update

If everything looks correct, try restarting the game or joining a different server.

How to get more Survive the Apocalypse codes

100MILLION, BIRTHDAY, BLOODHARVEST, FOREST, FORESTPT2, LAZYSLYGEMS, MILITARY, MILITARYTWO, NEWCLASSES, ONEMILLION, QUEST, RELEASE, SURVIVOR, TENMILLION, TWOMONTHS, WEAPONUPGRADE

Why these codes actually matter

At first, Survive the Apocalypse feels like a simple survival loop. You explore, fight zombies, collect loot, and try to last longer each run. But as the days progress, difficulty ramps up quickly, and small advantages start to matter.

From what I have seen, Emeralds are where the real progression happens. They let you unlock better classes and upgrades that directly impact your survivability. Without them, you are mostly relying on luck and basic gear.

Using codes early gives you a small but meaningful head start. It does not make the game easy, but it makes your early runs feel less punishing and more rewarding.

Update: Verified the latest Spin a Soccer Card Codes on August 04, 2026

If you enjoy collecting football cards, opening packs, and building something that keeps earning even when you are offline, Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox fits perfectly. The game blends simple mechanics with a satisfying loop: spin, unlock cards, place them on your plot, earn money, and repeat. What makes the experience even better is using codes, which give you a head start without the usual grind.

Below is everything you need to know, including the latest working codes, how to redeem them, and why they sometimes fail.

All Working Spin a Soccer Card Codes

  • HERO-CRYSTAL: (NEW) 2x packs (at rebirth level) and 3x extra spins
  • WEAREBACK: 2x packs (at rebirth level) and 3x extra spins

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Blue Lock Rivals Codes, BLR Legacy Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Spin a Soccer Card Codes

DRAGON-PRIME, OWL-HAPPY, BIGUPDATECOMING, BLAZE-STORM, nethercards, OMEGA-STAR, WOLF-METEOR, STORM, APRILDAY1, APRILDAY2, APRILDAY3, CHAMP-CRYSTAL, CHAMP-LEGEND, CHAMP-MOON, CRYSTAL-GOAL, EXCLUSIVECARDS, GOLDEN-BRONZE, GOLDEN-SHADOW, LETS0TRADE!, LETS1SPIN, LETS8TRADE!, LETSWISH, MOON-STRIKER, MYTHIC-CRYSTAL, RAVEN-OMEGA, RELEASE, RUBY-PRIME, TIGER-HAWK, TIGER-MEGA, TIGER-METEOR, TOURNAMENT, TOURNAMENT67, TRADEUPDATE, W0UPDATE, WOWNEWUPDATE11

How to Redeem Spin a Soccer Card Codes

Before redeeming, make sure you join the official Pixellar Studios Roblox group. Some players may also need to complete basic progress, like tutorial or rebirth requirements.

Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Click the Shop icon on the left side.
  4. Scroll down to find the Code section.
  5. Enter your code in the text box.
  6. Click Redeem.

Once redeemed, your rewards are added instantly.

Why These Codes Matter

Spin a Soccer Card is built around progression through packs and randomness. Normally, you earn money slowly by placing cards on your plot and reinvesting into new packs. Codes break this cycle early.

They give you free spins, packs, and sometimes large amounts of cash, letting you jump straight into better rewards. This is especially useful for new players trying to build a strong collection quickly.

Why Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it usually comes down to a few simple reasons:

  • Typing mistakes: Codes are case-sensitive, so even a small error breaks them
  • Server delay: New codes sometimes need a moment after updates
  • Expired codes: Many codes are time-limited and stop working without notice
  • Missing requirements: Some codes require joining the group or progressing in the game

The safest approach is to copy and paste codes exactly as listed.

How to Get More Codes

New codes are typically released during updates, events, or milestones. Developers usually share them through:

  • Official Pixellar Studios Roblox group
  • Discord server (#codes channel)

Since codes can expire quickly, checking regularly is important. Redeem them as soon as possible to avoid missing out.

You can also bookmark this page and check back often. We track new codes as soon as they drop and keep this list updated so you never miss free rewards.

Final Thoughts

Spin a Soccer Card works because it keeps things simple but rewarding. You open packs, chase rare players, and slowly turn your plot into a money-generating system. Codes accelerate that journey, giving you instant access to better cards and faster growth.

If you are just starting out, using codes early makes a noticeable difference. Instead of grinding for your first decent pack, you jump straight into the fun part of the game — collecting, upgrading, and building a stronger lineup.

title.rendered: Instagram Plus is coming: New features, price, and everything we know so far

content.rendered:
Meta is currently testing a new subscription called Instagram Plus, a premium tier that unlocks exclusive Story tools, advanced privacy controls, audience management features, and enhanced engagement insights. It’s like Instagram wants power users to pay for convenience, better experiences, more control, and premium tools.

And honestly, that’s the most interesting part. Instead of relying entirely on advertising revenue, Meta is approaching a subscription strategy with Facebook Plus, WhatsApp Plus, and Instagram Plus.

If you are curious about the new Instagram Plus subscription, here’s everything you need to know, including its features, eligibility, pricing, and availability.

What is Instagram Plus?

Instagram Plus is a new premium subscription currently being tested by Meta in select markets. After launching Instants, think of it as Instagram’s answer to Snapchat Plus. It gives subscribers access to tools that make Stories more useful, private, and customizable.

For heavy Instagram users, these upgrades may feel genuinely useful. For casual users, they may feel completely unnecessary. That’s probably exactly how Meta wants it.

Instagram Plus vs Meta Verified

A lot of users are confusing Instagram Plus with Meta Verified, but they serve very different purposes.

Meta Verified is all about identity verification. The subscription comes with a verified badge, account protection, and customer service access. Instagram Plus focuses on platform features.

In simple terms, Meta Verified helps prove who you are. Instagram Plus helps you do more on Instagram.

Instagram Plus subscription price: How much will it cost?

Meta has not officially announced global pricing, but testing data gives us a fairly good idea. Current trial pricing in some regions suggests Instagram Plus will be positioned as a low-cost subscription rather than a premium service. As per a TechCrunch report, pricing could be $3.99/month.

That pricing strategy makes sense. Meta is expected to keep the other app subscriptions, like WhatsApp Plus and Facebook Plus, around $3 to $4 as well. This indicates the company only wants millions of users to justify paying a few dollars every month.

If this turns out to be true, many users may subscribe simply for one feature alone: anonymous Story viewing.

Instagram Plus features: Everything available so far

The most interesting thing about Instagram Plus is that almost every feature revolves around Stories. That’s probably not a coincidence. Stories have become one of Instagram’s most-used formats, and Meta appears to be turning them into a premium experience.

1. Anonymous Story previews

This is likely the feature generating the most attention. Instagram Plus allows users to preview Stories without appearing in the viewer list.

For years, users have relied on third-party apps and questionable workarounds to do this. Instagram Plus appears to bring the feature directly into the platform.

2. Extend Stories up to 48 hours

Typically, Instagram Stories expire after 24 hours. With Instagram Plus, users may extend Story visibility to 48 hours.

It’s great news for creators, brands, and businesses as they may generate more views and interaction without reposting the same content again and again.

3. Story rewatch insights

We can already check Instagram Story statistics. Now, the Plus subscribers will receive even more information. They may get to see when people rewatch certain Stories.

This creates a new layer of engagement tracking. A Story that gets viewed twice might be more valuable than one viewed once by twice as many people.

4. Searchable Story viewer list

Anyone who receives thousands of Story views understands the pain of scrolling endlessly through viewer lists.

Instagram Plus introduces search functionality for Story viewers. It’s a small upgrade, but one that creators and business users will likely appreciate.

5. Unlimited Story audience lists

Currently, we rely on Close Friends. Instagram Plus will make a great leap from there, allowing the subscribers to create audience groups and determine exactly whom their Stories will be visible to.

Imagine having separate Story lists for:

  • Family
  • Close friends
  • Work colleagues
  • Customers
  • VIP followers

It’s a simple idea, but one that dramatically improves audience control.

6. Story Spotlight feature

One of the more mysterious additions is Story Spotlight. Based on early testing information, this feature appears designed to increase Story visibility and reach.

Meta hasn’t fully explained how it works, but it could function as a lightweight promotion tool that helps selected Stories gain additional exposure.

7. Super Hearts and Premium reactions

Instagram Plus also introduces enhanced reactions. These include exclusive reactions with special effects and premium engagement options that help interactions stand out.

The feature sounds minor on paper, but social platforms have repeatedly shown that users enjoy exclusive digital status symbols. Just look at Snapchat Plus, Discord Nitro, and Telegram Premium.

Hidden changes most people are missing

Most coverage focuses on the features. The real story is what these features reveal about Instagram’s future.

  • For years, Instagram has been supported almost entirely by advertising. But now it’s quietly becoming a subscription platform. If Instagram Plus succeeds, don’t be surprised if additional paid tiers appear in the future.
  • Stories are becoming Instagram’s most valuable product. That tells us where Meta believes user attention is heading.
  • This could be the beginning of a larger subscription ecosystem. Meta’s head of product, Naomi Gleit, discussed new Meta One plans for AI users, creators, and businesses.

Which countries have Instagram Plus right now?

Instagram Plus is currently available only in limited testing markets.

Reports suggest users in countries such as Japan, Mexico, and the Philippines have seen access to the subscription during testing phases. Meta has not announced a complete list of supported regions.

That’s important because many users searching for Instagram Plus won’t find the option in their app yet. And at the moment, Meta has not confirmed a global launch date.

How to subscribe to Instagram Plus

If Instagram Plus becomes available for your account, subscribing should be straightforward.

Steps to buy Instagram Plus:

  1. Open the Instagram app on your mobile.
  2. Tap your profile picture to go to your profile.
  3. Select the menu icon and go to Accounts Center.
  4. Tap Subscriptions and select Instagram Plus.
  5. Hit Continue. Review the payment options and confirm your purchase.
  6. Complete payment through the App Store or Google Play Store.

Manage your subscription

After subscribing, you can manage your plan through Instagram Settings and Apple App Store or Google Play subscriptions.

Users will be able to:

  • view their subscription details,
  • check renewal date,
  • update payment method,
  • And cancel the subscription at any time.

What happens if you cancel Instagram Plus?

If you cancel Instagram Plus, your premium benefits will remain active until the current billing cycle ends.

After that:

  • Story previewing will be removed.
  • Extended Story duration features may disappear.
  • Premium audience tools will no longer be available.
  • Exclusive reactions and enhancements may be disabled.

Your account itself will remain unchanged. You won’t lose followers, posts, messages, or existing content.

Who should consider Instagram Plus?

Instagram Plus might not be for everyone, but some users might find it very helpful.

Get Instagram Plus if you:

  • Post Stories regularly
  • Manage a creator account
  • Run a business on Instagram
  • Need advanced audience controls
  • Want deeper Story analytics
  • Care about privacy features

Skip it if you:

  • Rarely post Stories
  • Use Instagram casually
  • Primarily watch Reels
  • Don’t care about engagement metrics

For many users, the free version will remain more than enough.

Final verdict: Is Instagram Plus worth it?

Instagram Plus may look like a collection of small features, but it represents a much bigger shift inside Meta. The company isn’t simply adding premium Story tools. It’s testing whether users are willing to pay for a better Instagram experience.

Some features feel genuinely useful. I really liked the idea of anonymous Story previewing, advanced audience controls, and deeper Story insights. Other features make the subscription feel complete.

What do you think about Instagram’s new paid subscription? Share your opinion in the comments below!

Update: Verified the latest Playground Basketball Codes on July 30, 2026

If you’ve been grinding Playground Basketball and watching your coin balance go nowhere, you’re not alone. The good news? There are active codes right now that hand you free coins, and using them takes less than a minute. Here’s everything you need: working codes, how to redeem them, and where to find more when these expire.

All Working Playground Basketball Codes

  • RECUPDATE: 4.5k coins (NEW)
  • PGBUGC: 4.5k coins (NEW)
  • UPDATE8: 4.5k coins

That’s up to 16,500 free coins if you redeem all three right now. That’s real progress toward move animations, stat upgrades, and cosmetics you’d otherwise grind hours for.

You can also grab rewards with Anime Last Stand codes, Anime Defenders codes, or explore all Roblox game codes for more freebies.

Expired Playground Basketball Codes

UPDATE7, UPDATE5, STAGE, 25MVISITS

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Playground Basketball Codes

Before anything else, there’s one thing most people miss that makes codes fail entirely. You must join the “Playground Basketball | Community” group on Roblox before codes will work. It’s a free group, just search it up on Roblox and hit Join. Skip this step and no code in the world will go through.

Once you’re in the group, here’s how to redeem:

  1. Launch Playground Basketball on Roblox and stay on the main menu.
  2. Look for the blue gift box icon in the top right corner and click it.
  3. A text field will pop up; type or paste your code there.
  4. Hit Redeem, and your coins will show up in your balance instantly.

One important tip: don’t type codes manually if you can avoid it. A single wrong character will give you an error, and it’s easy to waste time troubleshooting something that isn’t actually broken. Just copy the code straight from this article and paste it in.

Why Isn’t My Playground Basketball Code Working?

It’s frustrating when a code fails, but it’s almost always one of three things. First, check if the code has expired. If it’s in the expired list above, it’s done. Second, look for typos if you typed it manually. Third, if the game just got an update, give the servers a few minutes to stabilize before trying again, because fresh updates sometimes cause temporary redemption issues.

And the most overlooked reason of all? Not being in the community group. Double-check that first before anything else.

How to Get More Playground Basketball Codes

The developers drop new codes during game updates and when the game hits milestone numbers like visit counts or like counts. The faster the community grows, the more codes get released.

The two best ways to stay ahead are:

  • Bookmark this page so you catch codes as soon as they drop.
  • Join the Playground Basketball Guilded or Discord server, where the dev team posts codes in the updates channel directly. It’s the fastest way to catch a code before it expires.

Liking the game on its Roblox page also helps it reach milestones faster, which means more codes for everyone.

What Is Playground Basketball?

If you’re new to it, Playground Basketball is a Roblox sports game that’s more grounded than most. Forget the aura-farming and over-the-top dunks of other Roblox sports games. This one is about actually getting better. You build a customized player, train to improve your stats and traits, and take on real players in 1v1 or 2v2 matches across different courts, including city courts, park courts, and your own private practice area.

Coins are the currency that makes progression possible. They buy you new move animations, stat upgrades, and cosmetics. That’s exactly why these codes matter: they cut down the grind and let you focus on actually playing.

Check out more Roblox game codes:

  • Evil Plate Game Codes
  • Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes
  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes

Update: Verified the latest Evil Plate Game Codes on August 03, 2026

Surviving a round in Evil Plate Game is never easy. One moment you are standing safely on your floating plate, and the next moment lightning strikes, lasers appear, or the ground suddenly shrinks beneath your feet. The chaos is exactly what makes the game so fun.

To make things a little easier, developers occasionally release Evil Plate Game codes. These codes give players free shards, the main in‑game currency used to unlock cosmetics, emotes, and other fun items. Redeeming them is one of the fastest ways to collect shards without grinding through rounds.

Below you will find all the latest Evil Plate Game codes along with how to redeem them and what the rewards are used for.

All Working Evil Plate Game Codes

  • OPTIMIZED (NEW)
  • THECAKEISALIE (NEW)
  • MEWISES
  • LILDURK2022
  • 4THOFJULY

  • UPDATE1FIXES
  • 4MVisits
  • TUTORIAL
  • 5MIL
  • UPDATE1
  • EPG
  • MOAR!
  • EASTER!
  • 7UP
  • 2M!

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Tap Simulator codes, Titan Fishing codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Evil Plate Game Codes

100K, 1MTY, 1POINT5M, 200K, 300K, 500K, 600K, 700K, 800K, 900K, BUGTHANKS, CELTICS, FOOLISH, FOXY, HBDSHOOTA, OOPS, SPUI, XO

How to Redeem Evil Plate Game Codes

Redeeming codes in Evil Plate Game is slightly different from many other Roblox games because the code menu is accessed through an NPC in the lobby.

Follow these steps to redeem your rewards:

  1. Launch Evil Plate Game on Roblox.
  2. Spawn into the lobby area.
  3. Turn toward the shop area or leaderboard.
  4. Interact with the NPC to open the code window.
  5. Find the Codes NPC near the shop or leaderboard.
  6. Enter your code in the text box.
  7. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, the shards will be instantly added to your account.

What Are Shards Used For in Evil Plate Game

Shards are the main currency in Evil Plate Game. Players earn them by surviving rounds, completing quests, logging in regularly, or redeeming codes.

You can spend shards on:

  • Cosmetic items such as horns, halos, and visual accessories
  • Emotes that allow you to interact with other players
  • Crates that unlock additional cosmetic rewards

These items do not affect gameplay strength. They simply add personality and fun to your character while you try to survive the chaos.

Another interesting mechanic in the game is the karma system. Players can use shards to bless or curse other players during a match. Depending on your choices, your karma meter will shift toward positive or negative values.

Why Evil Plate Game Codes May Not Work

Sometimes a code might fail to redeem even if it looks correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons.

  1. Code has expired after a game update or milestone.
  2. The code was entered incorrectly.
  3. The code has already been redeemed on your account.

Copying and pasting the code directly is usually the easiest way to avoid typing mistakes.

How to Get More Evil Plate Game Codes

New codes usually appear when the game reaches milestones such as visit counts, like goals, or major updates. Developers also release them occasionally to celebrate bug fixes or community events.

The best way to stay updated is to follow the game’s official community channels and Discord server. Many players prefer bookmarking our page so they can quickly check back for new codes, since we update the list whenever fresh rewards are released.

What is Evil Plate Game?

Evil Plate Game is a chaotic Roblox survival experience where each player stands on their own floating plate while random disasters constantly try to eliminate them. Lightning strikes, lasers fire across the arena, gravity may change suddenly, and platforms can shrink or sink without warning.

The goal is simple: survive longer than everyone else. As players are eliminated, the tension rises until only one person remains standing. That final survivor wins the round and earns the glory.

Because every round is unpredictable, quick reactions and good movement matter a lot. But with the help of free shards from codes, you can unlock fun cosmetics and enjoy the chaos in style.

Update: Verified the latest Diesel n Steel Codes on June 30, 2026

Running a Jeepney business in Diesel n’ Steel can be surprisingly demanding. Between buying new vehicles, repairing damage, paying for fuel, and upgrading your ride, you will constantly need more cash to keep things moving. The good news is that the developers occasionally release Diesel n Steel codes that reward players with free in‑game cash and other bonuses.

These rewards can give you a useful head start, especially when you are still building your first Jeepney route and learning how the game works. Below you will find the latest working Diesel n Steel codes along with instructions on how to redeem them.

All Working Diesel n Steel Codes

  • catcatcatcatcat: Free Cash (NEW)
  • kmjsdns: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • xltrelease: 6767 Cash and 670 EXP (NEW)
  • 3.8k: 5000 Cash and 167 EXP (NEW)
  • cadez_is_best: 4200 Cash and 69 EXP
  • DelayUpdate: Free cash
  • 60K: Free cash
  • <3: Free cash
  • Spawn Bug: Free cash
  • Milwaukee: Free cash

Keep in mind that Roblox codes can expire without warning, so it is always a good idea to redeem them as soon as possible.

Expired Diesel n Steel Codes

2026, AOITHEINVESTOR, BERMONTHS2025, BIGUPDATE!, BOSSREI, BUGCOMPENSATION, BUGFIX, CADEZ, COMPENSATION, DNSNUMBAWAN, DNSXMNLR21, FK, GIFTING, HAPPY10MVISITS, HAPPY20MVISITS, HAPPY25MVISITS, HAPPYXMAS2025, HIROMI, JAMBOHATDOGKAYAMOBATO, JAMDELABUSE, KAMOTE, MERVIN#1, PARZIGAMING, PATIENCE, PHASE2, PISO, PLSMONEY, SIOPASH, SUB2BOYIMBO, SUB2DAVEFROMPH, SWEETPOTATOLOVER, TEX, TRES, TY, WHOSEVIL?

How to Redeem Diesel n Steel Codes

Before you can redeem codes in Diesel n Steel, you need to reach a small milestone in the game. Once that requirement is complete, claiming rewards only takes a few seconds.

  1. Launch Diesel n Steel on Roblox.
  2. Play the game until you reach 500 EXP.
  3. Click the gift box icon or open the menu in the game interface.
  4. Select the Codes option.
  5. Enter a working code into the text field.
  6. Click Redeem to receive your reward.

If the code is valid, the rewards will be added to your account immediately.

Why Diesel n Steel Codes Are Useful

Diesel n Steel is a Roblox driving simulator set in Bulacan, Philippines, where players run a Jeepney transport business. Your goal is simple: buy a Jeepney, drive passengers along routes, and earn money while navigating busy roads.

However, running the business is not as easy as it sounds. You will need money for fuel, repairs, upgrades, and sometimes entirely new Jeepneys. Since earning cash through gameplay can take time, codes offer a quick way to get extra funds without grinding for hours.

Update: Verified the latest Titan Fishing Codes on August 03, 2026

Titan Fishing is one of those Roblox games where patience, timing, and persistence matter just as much as luck. Instead of catching small fish, players face enormous sea creatures that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Each battle becomes a test of speed and endurance as you tap continuously to weaken the fish before the time runs out.

To progress faster, Titan Fishing codes can give you useful rewards like free money, exclusive rod skins, and powerful skill books. These rewards help you roll for stronger abilities and improve your chances of landing massive catches.

All Working Titan Fishing Codes

  • TAIJIEVENT: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • TITANFISHING: Godzilla Blade Skin
  • 1MVISITS: 50K Money

These rewards are particularly useful early on. Money allows you to roll for skill books, while items like Mythical Books can unlock powerful abilities that make catching giant fish significantly easier.

Expired Titan Fishing Codes

LOVES2026, SORRY2026

How to Redeem Titan Fishing Codes

Redeeming codes in Titan Fishing only takes a few seconds once you know where to look. Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Titan Fishing in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the code redemption box.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

If the code is valid, the rewards will instantly appear in your account.

Check the All Roblox Game Codes Master List to find working codes for every game.

What Rewards Do Titan Fishing Codes Give?

Titan Fishing codes usually reward players with items that help progress faster in the game. These rewards may include:

  • Money used for rolling skill books
  • Rod skins for customizing your fishing rod
  • Skill books that grant powerful fishing abilities

Skill books are especially important because they directly affect your fishing power and strategy.

What Are Skill Books in Titan Fishing?

Skill Books are special items obtained by rolling at an NPC in the game. Each roll grants one random book, with rarities ranging from common books to extremely rare Mythical books.

Without skill books, fishing becomes far more difficult. These abilities improve your effectiveness when battling giant fish, which is why players often spend large amounts of money rolling for better books.

The price of each roll increases over time. For example:

  • First roll: 20,000 money
  • Second roll: 21,000 money
  • Third roll: 22,000 money

Because the price increases with every roll, free money from codes can be extremely valuable.

Why Titan Fishing Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail to redeem even if it appears correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons:

  1. The code has expired. Codes often stop working after updates or milestone events. If a code is expired, the game will reject it.
  2. Typing mistakes. Titan Fishing codes are case‑sensitive, so even a small typo or missing character can prevent redemption. Copying and pasting the code usually avoids this problem.
  3. Server issues. Occasionally, the server may not process the code correctly. Leaving the game and joining a new server often fixes the issue.

How to Get More Titan Fishing Codes

New Titan Fishing codes are usually released when the game reaches major milestones or receives updates.

The best way to find new codes quickly is by checking the official Titan Fishing Discord server, where developers often post announcements and update notes. You can also follow community pages and developer social media accounts where new codes are occasionally shared.

Bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update this guide whenever new Titan Fishing codes are released, so you never miss free rewards.

What Is Titan Fishing?

Titan Fishing is a Roblox fishing game where players hunt for massive fish that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Instead of passive fishing, every catch turns into an active battle where you must tap rapidly to damage the fish before the timer expires.

Players earn money from successful catches, which can then be used to roll for powerful skill books, upgrade abilities, and customize their rods with skins.

Over time, you build a stronger fishing setup and take on even larger sea creatures. The mix of progression, skill upgrades, and intense fishing battles is what makes Titan Fishing stand out from typical Roblox fishing games.

With new updates and milestone rewards appearing regularly, redeeming the latest Titan Fishing codes is one of the easiest ways to stay ahead and strengthen your fishing build.

  • Diesel n Steel Codes

Update: Verified the latest Jujutsu Legacy Codes on July 21, 2026

If you are grinding your way through Jujutsu Legacy and trying to build the perfect character, spins are everything. Your race, clan, and technique define how strong you become, and early on, getting enough spins can feel slow and frustrating. That is where these Jujutsu Legacy codes help. They give you free technique, clan, and race spins so you can reroll until you land the build you actually want.

Below you will find all working codes, expired codes, and clear steps to redeem them.

All Working Jujutsu Legacy Codes

  • LimitlessV2: Race, Clan, and Technique spins (NEW)
  • Dabura: Free Technique spins
  • ShinjukuShowdown: Free Technique spins
  • MutualLove: 40 Technique spins
  • Dessert: Free Technique spins
  • Mahoraga: 30 Technique spins
  • WUpd: 30 Technique spins
  • Just This Once: 10 Technique spins
  • Takaba: 20 Technique spins
  • AlwaysBetOnHakari: 20 Clan Spin
  • Sorry: 20 Technique Spins
  • SkyManipulation: 20 Technique Spins
  • Cursed: 10 Technique Spins
  • SkillIssue: 3 Technique Spins

These spins let you reroll your current setup. Keep in mind that when you spin, it replaces your currently equipped race, clan, or technique. If you get something rare and do not want to lose it later, store it in your technique storage before spinning again.

Expired Jujutsu Legacy Codes

1.5KLIKES, 10KLIKES, 11KLIKES, 12KLIKES, 2.5KLIKES, 2KLIKES, 3.5KLIKES, 3KLIKES, 4.5KLIKES, 4KLIKES, 5.5KLIKES, 5KLIKES, 6.5KLIKES, 6KLIKES, 7.5KLIKES, 7KLIKES, 8.5KLIKES, 8KLIKES, 9.5KLIKES, 9KLIKES, BLOODMANIPULATION, CAT GOJO, CHRISTMAS1, COMEDIAN, DISASTERFLAMES, GIFTS, HANAMI, HIGURUMA, INFINITY, ISHIGORI, JACKPOT, KRAMPUS SUKUNA, RACESPIN2, SORRYFORGIVESPECIALCLAN, SORRYFORINFBUGS, SORRYSHUTDOWN, WCHRISTMAS

How To Redeem Jujutsu Legacy Codes

Before you redeem any code, you must reach level 5. You can do this quickly by defeating Jujutsu students near the spawn area.

Once you are level 5, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Jujutsu Legacy in Roblox.
  2. Press M or tap the menu button on the left side of your screen.
  3. Enter a working code in the redeem box.
  4. Press OK or hit Enter on your keyboard.

Your free spins will be added instantly.

To use your spins, head to the building near the spawn point and talk to the relevant NPC. Choose whether you want to spin for technique, clan, or race.

What Are Jujutsu Legacy Codes?

Jujutsu Legacy codes are free rewards released by the developer, kauan123ro. Most new codes appear when the game hits milestones, such as 5KLIKES or 10KLIKES. Sometimes they also drop during updates or as compensation for bugs and shutdowns.

That is why you see codes like SorryShutdown or SorryForInfBugs. They are usually apology rewards and often give large amounts of spins.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code does not redeem, check the following:

  • Make sure you are level 5.
  • Double-check spelling. Codes are case sensitive.
  • Copy and paste directly to avoid typing mistakes.
  • The code may have expired.
  • The game may have just updated. Wait a few minutes and try again.

How to Get More Jujutsu Legacy Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to check this page regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes are released.

You can also join the official Jujutsu Legacy Discord server and check the codes channel for announcements from the developer.

If you are serious about building the perfect character, these free spins make a huge difference. Instead of settling for average stats, you can keep rolling until you land the combo that actually feels powerful.

Use the codes, store your rare rolls wisely, and keep leveling. The right build can completely change how Jujutsu Legacy feels to play.

Related articles worth reading

  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Evil Plate Game Codes

Update: Verified the latest Mojave Valley Codes on August 03, 2026

Mojave Valley is one of those Roblox roleplay games that instantly pulls you in. Inspired by California and built around a huge Mojave Desert-style map, it lets you cruise through busy streets, drive realistic cars, buy homes, and build a virtual life with friends. But just like real life, everything costs money, and earning it from scratch can feel slow.

That’s where Mojave Valley codes come in. These limited-time promo codes give you free in-game cash and rewards so you can skip some of the grind and jump straight into the fun parts like fast cars, better houses, and smoother roleplay.

All Working Mojave Valley Codes

  • THIRTYMILLIONVISITS: Free Cash (NEW)
  • JULY4TH: Free Cash (NEW)
  • DANGEROUSWOMAN: Free Cash (NEW)
  • EXPANSIONUPDATE: Free Rewards
  • JDMIMPORTS: Free Rewards
  • ELEVENMILLION: 5k cash
  • TENMILLION: 5k cash
  • APRILFOOLS: 8k cash
  • LUNARYEAR: 15k Cash

If a code says “Free rewards,” the exact amount may vary depending on the update or server. The LUNARYEAR code currently gives a confirmed 15,000 cash, making it the most valuable active reward right now.

If you’re hunting for more freebies, check out the latest Solo Hunters codes, Knockout codes, and Horse Life codes to claim free rewards, boosts, and in-game currency before they expire.

Expired Mojave Valley Codes

BUGFIX, BURNTKITCHEN, CATALINAISLAND_TANKED, DELAYED, HALLOWEEN, HYDROLOCKED, LAAATEEEEE, LASTWORD, LIKES150, LIKES3500, MIYLOTANKED, MOJAVERETURNS, NEWYEARS, PRESSPRESS, STREAMPF2, TANKLATER, TWOMILLIONVISITS, WINTER

How to Redeem Mojave Valley Codes

Redeeming codes is simple and only takes a few seconds.

  1. Launch Mojave Valley in Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Open the Codes tab.
  4. Enter a working code into the “Enter Code” box.
  5. Press the arrow button to claim your reward.

If the code is valid, your cash or reward will be added instantly.

Why Your Mojave Valley Codes Are Not Working

If a code does not work, here are the common reasons:

  • The code was typed incorrectly. Copy and paste to avoid mistakes.
  • The code has expired.
  • The server has not refreshed yet. Some new codes only work on fresh servers.

If you lose in-game money or progress, you can contact the developers through their official Discord server and open a ticket. Include your username and details of what was lost.

Where to Find More Mojave Valley Codes

To stay updated with new codes:

  • Join the official Mojave Valley Discord server.
  • Check the game’s Roblox page for announcements.
  • Bookmark this page and check back regularly for new updates.

There is currently no official Mojave Valley Wiki or Trello board, so Discord is the main source for updates.

Why Mojave Valley Codes Matter

Starting in Mojave Valley with zero cash can feel slow. You spend hours driving basic cars just to afford a decent upgrade. Codes change that experience.

Free cash lets you:

  • Buy faster cars earlier
  • Unlock better homes
  • Catch up to experienced players
  • Focus on roleplay instead of grinding

Developers usually release codes during updates, events, holidays, or milestone celebrations. They are meant as thank-you rewards for the community.

What Is Mojave Valley?

Mojave Valley is a California-inspired driving and roleplay experience set on a large map based on the Mojave Desert. The world includes highways, city roads, tall buildings, and open desert areas. The cars are designed to feel realistic, with proper driving controls and gear shifting.

You can:

  • Drive detailed, realistic vehicles
  • Earn money through in-game activities
  • Buy houses and luxury properties
  • Socialize and roleplay with other players
  • Build your own lifestyle inside the city

For players who enjoy open-world roleplay games like Jupiter Florida or Southwest Florida, Mojave Valley offers a similar but unique desert-city vibe.

Final Thoughts

Mojave Valley is about building a life inside a living desert city that focuses on driving, earning, socializing, and upgrading. Codes simply make that journey faster and more enjoyable. Instead of grinding for hours, you can jump into the parts that make the game exciting.

If you enjoy realistic cars, open-world roleplay, and building your own virtual lifestyle, Mojave Valley is worth your time, especially when you start with free cash in your pocket.

Update: Verified the latest Universal Tower Defense Codes on August 03, 2026

Tower defense remains one of the most consistent and competitive genres on Roblox. Universal Tower Defense (UTD) builds on that foundation by combining strategic wave defense with anime-inspired units and progression-driven gameplay. As difficulty increases, redeemable codes can provide valuable resources that help players strengthen their teams faster.

Below is the complete and updated breakdown of Universal Tower Defense codes, including what works, what has expired, and how everything actually works.

All Working Universal Tower Defense Codes

  • Football11!: 100 Trait Rerolls, 20,000 Gems, and 100,000 Gold (NEW)
  • UniversalFootball!: (NEW) 25 Trait Rerolls, 25 Relic Rerolls, 25 Stat Rerolls, 25 Stat Locks, and 100,000 Universal Gems Season 1 Part 2
  • NewBlitzPass!: 50 Trait Rerolls, and 5,000 Gems (NEW)
  • WeLoveYoruichi2!: 250 Rerolls
  • WeLoveYoruichi!: Yoruichi, Evo Items, 250 Trait Rerolls, 6 Etherealization Shards (Mythic), and Summer Crate x5 (Level 15+)
  • UTDZApologyForBugs!: 1500 Trait Rerolls, 1x Boundless Orb
  • WeLoveUTDZ!: Fern, Fern Evo Items, 12 Mythic Etherealization Shards, Kenpachi EVO
  • SrryForWhoopsie!: 1 Ruler Ticket
  • ReaperVsHollowDestroyers: 50 Trait Rerolls and 10k Gems
  • SpectacularSpider!: 50 Trait Rerolls and 100k Universal Gems Season 1 Part 1
  • TheGuyFromSmash!: 50 Trait Rerolls and 100k Universal Gems Season 1 Part 2
  • Summer2026!: 50 Trait Rerolls and 10k Summer Currency

Multiple recent updates indicate that all previously released codes have expired. New codes usually arrive alongside major updates or milestone celebrations, but at the moment, there are none active.

New codes can release at any time, especially after patches or major announcements, so it is worth checking back regularly.

WINTERPOLLS, WINTERTIME!, WINTERUPD, YT10K!

What Do Universal Tower Defense Codes Give You?

When active, UTD codes usually provide progression resources that directly improve your units.

Gems are used for summoning new characters. Trait Rerolls let you re-roll unit traits for better bonuses. Stat Rerolls and Stat Locks help you fine-tune performance. Limited-event currencies like Ice Gifts and Spirit Souls are often tied to seasonal updates.

If you are struggling against later waves, rerolls can make a noticeable difference. A single strong trait can completely change how your team performs.

How to Redeem Universal Tower Defense Codes

Redeeming codes in Universal Tower Defense is simple once you know where to look.

  1. Launch Universal Tower Defense in Roblox.
  2. Click the “Codes” button on the right side of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  4. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

If you receive an error, double-check spelling and capitalization. Codes are case-sensitive and expire without notice.

Why Aren’t My UTD Codes Working?

If a code does not redeem, it usually means one of three things:

  1. The code has expired.
  2. There is a typo or formatting mistake.
  3. The game client may not be fully updated.

After major patches, servers sometimes need a few minutes to stabilize. If you are certain the code is correct, close and relaunch the game before trying again.

How to Get More Universal Tower Defense Codes

New codes are typically shared through the game’s official Discord server. Developers post them during updates, milestone celebrations, or special announcements.

However, codes are often scattered across announcements and not always organized. The best way to stay updated is to check this page regularly, as we update it immediately whenever new Universal Tower Defense codes arrive.

Universal Tower Defense continues to attract anime fans who enjoy building teams inspired by iconic series like Naruto, One Piece, and Dragon Ball-style characters. With new units and balance patches rolling out over time, fresh codes are likely to return.

For now, there are no active rewards available. When new codes release, they typically provide meaningful progression boosts. If you are planning to summon or reroll soon, waiting for the next code update may help you save valuable resources.

Update: Verified the latest 99 Nights in the Forest Codes on August 03, 2026

Surviving in 99 Nights in the Forest is not easy. One mistake in the dark and you are surrounded by cultists, trapped by wolves, or chased back to camp by the Deer. Resources are limited, nights grow harder, and the wrong Class can slow your progress. That is why 99 Nights in the Forest codes are important. They give you free Gems, and Gems directly improve your chances of survival.

Below you will find all active codes, how to redeem them correctly, including the hidden chat method, and practical tips to earn more Gems while pushing toward Night 99.

Active 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

  • forestwakesup26: 15 Diamonds and three flames (NEW)
  • afterparty: 15 Diamonds

Expired 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

HAPPYHALLOWEEN

How to Redeem 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

There are two different ways to redeem codes in this game. Most players only know about one.

Standard Lobby Method

Most codes must be redeemed in the lobby before starting a match.

  1. Launch 99 Nights in the Forest on Roblox.
  2. Stay in the matchmaking lobby.
  3. Click the Gems or diamond icon in the lower left corner, or speak to the currency NPC.
  4. Click the blue Codes button in the bottom right.
  5. Enter the code exactly as shown.
  6. Press Submit.

If the code is active, your Gems, sometimes labeled as Diamonds in the interface, will be added instantly.

Special Chat Method for “yay fishing”

The yay fishing code does not work in the Codes menu. It must be entered in chat while fishing.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Start a solo or multiplayer lobby.
  2. Upgrade your Campfire to Level 2.
  3. Locate the Fishing Shack.
  4. Pick up the Old Rod.
  5. Use the rod at any fishing hole.
  6. While actively fishing, press “/” to open chat.
  7. Type yay fishing and press Enter.

If done correctly, you will receive 2 Gems immediately. It is a small reward, but Gems are not easy to earn, so every bonus matters.

What Are Gems Used For?

Gems are the main premium currency in 99 Nights in the Forest. They are not cosmetic rewards. They affect gameplay and progression.

You can spend Gems to:

  • Unlock new Classes
  • Reroll Talents
  • Purchase options from the Daily Class Shop

Classes play a major role in survival. Some are better suited for solo players, while others are designed for coordinated teams. If you struggle in the later nights, upgrading your Class often makes the biggest difference.

How to Earn More Gems Without Codes

Codes provide a helpful boost, but long term progress depends on survival and smart strategy.

Here are the main ways to earn more Gems:

  • Survive more nights in a single run. The longer you last, the more Gems you earn.
  • Rescue Missing Kids to increase your Day Multiplier.
  • Build Beds early to speed up day progression.
  • Participate in Admin Abuse events, which typically happen before or during Saturday updates.
  • Purchase the Survival Kit for 299 Robux, which includes 20 Gems and two playable Classes.

The deeper your run goes, the better the rewards. At the same time, enemy difficulty increases rapidly.

Why Your Code Is Not Working

If a code fails to redeem, check the following:

  • The code may have expired.
  • You may not be in the lobby for standard redemption.
  • There could be a spelling error.
  • Servers may not have refreshed after an update.
  • You may not have completed the required steps for special codes, such as fishing.

Copy and paste codes whenever possible to avoid typing mistakes.

How to Get More 99 Nights in the Forest Codes

New codes usually appear during major updates, seasonal events, or special milestones. Since the game does not release codes frequently, staying informed gives you an advantage.

Here are the best ways to find new codes early:

  • Join the official 99 Nights in the Forest Discord server for update announcements.
  • Follow the developers on X for event news and patch updates.
  • Check the game’s Roblox community page for announcements.
  • Revisit this guide regularly for verified working codes.

Codes often drop around content updates, balance changes, or holiday events. If a big update goes live, it is always worth checking for new rewards.

What Is 99 Nights in the Forest?

99 Nights in the Forest is a Roblox survival horror game where players must survive 99 increasingly dangerous nights in a haunted forest. Your mission is to locate Missing Kids while crafting tools, gathering supplies, and defending against hostile creatures, including the Deer and the Cultist King.

The game blends survival mechanics with horror tension. You can play solo or team up with others. Coordinated teams generally survive longer, especially in the late game.

Final Thoughts

Free codes in 99 Nights in the Forest are limited, which makes each one valuable. Right now, afterparty, happyhalloween, and the special yay fishing method are the available ways to earn free rewards.

Redeem them early, invest your Gems wisely, build your multipliers quickly, and never let your campfire burn out. If you make it past Night 50, you are already ahead of most players.

  • Jujutsu Legacy Codes
  • Mojave Valley Codes

Update: Verified the latest Knockout Codes on August 03, 2026

Knockout throws you onto a shrinking sheet of ice with nothing but a direction and a power slider. You lock in your move without seeing anyone else’s choice. Then the timer ends. Every penguin launches at once. Collisions decide who survives and who disappears into the water.

Because matches are fast and skill-based, progression mostly comes from cosmetics. Ice lets you unlock skins. Spins give you prize wheel rewards. Limited-time events add special currencies like Hearts. Instead of grinding match after match, you can use Roblox Knockout codes to claim these rewards instantly.

Below is the complete and updated list of all working Knockout codes.

All Working Roblox Knockout Codes

  • EMPERORRETURNS: 500 Ice (NEW)
  • THANKSFORPLAYING: 3 Spins (NEW)

Ice is the main in-game currency used to unlock cosmetic skins. Spins let you try your luck on the prize wheel. Hearts are limited-time event rewards. Skins are purely cosmetic, meaning they do not give you any gameplay advantage, but they absolutely make you look experienced.

Codes are case-sensitive, so enter them exactly as shown.

Looking for working game codes? Find the latest Solo Hunters codes, Horse Life codes, and BLR Legacy codes with free in-game rewards.

Expired Knockout Codes

100K, ADMINABUSE, BEMMY, BOOGIE, BUNDUN, CIRCUSEVENT, COLD, CRABRAVE, DELAY, DISCO, DOOMSDAY, FOLTYNADMINABUSE, HAPPYEASTER, HOTPOTATOMODE, LANARAE, LAVA, LIKES, LOVE, LUNAR, MAPS, POOLMAP, PUNCHMONKEY, RUSSO, SOCIALHUB, SORRY, SORRYQUESTS, SORRYVALENTINES, SPRING, STEAK, STPATRICKS, TEAMS, TEMPLETILES, THANKS, VALENTINES, VINDOOLY

How to Redeem Knockout Codes

Redeeming codes in Knockout only takes a few seconds. Here is what you need to do:

  1. Launch Knockout in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings (cog icon) in the bottom corner of the screen.
  3. Enter a working code in the Enter Code Here text box.
  4. Press Redeem.

If the code is valid, you will receive your rewards instantly.

To avoid typos, copy and paste the code directly. Even a small extra space can cause an error.

Why Are My Knockout Codes Not Working?

If your code does not work, here are the most common reasons:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed it incorrectly.
  • You added extra spaces.
  • Your server is bugged after a recent update.

If you suspect a server issue, try rejoining a new server. Always double-check your spelling, as codes are case-sensitive.

Do Skins Give an Advantage?

No. Skins in Knockout are purely cosmetic. They do not increase strength, speed, or knockback power. The game is fully skill-based. Skins simply indicate that you have played long enough to unlock them. They help you look intimidating when you push someone into the icy void.

How to Get More Roblox Knockout Codes

New codes are usually released during updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To find more codes:

  • Join the braxworks Discord server and check the Announcements channel.
  • Join the braxworks Roblox group for updates.
  • Bookmark this page and check back regularly.

We update this list whenever new codes drop, so saving this page ensures you never miss free rewards.

Use these free codes to unlock new skins, spin rewards, and customize your penguin. Then step back onto the ice, read your opponents carefully, and aim with confidence. Only one penguin survives each round. Make sure it is yours.

Update: Verified the latest You vs Homer Codes on June 01, 2026

You VS Homer is one of the most chaotic hide-and-seek experiences on Roblox right now. Most players spawn as Bart and try to survive, while one player becomes Homer and hunts everyone down. Winning feels good, but for many players, the real progression happens in the shop.

Skins are the main reward loop in this game. Since earning currency takes time, promo codes are the fastest way to grab free cosmetics without extra grinding. Below are the only working You VS Homer codes.

All Working You VS Homer Codes

  • BUNNYEGGS2026: 250 Eggs (NEW)
  • LEEEEEPROCHAUN: 300 Clovers
  • FREEQUIDZ: 500 Coins

Quidz is the main in-game currency. You use it to buy Bart and Homer skins from the shop. Some skins are expensive, so free Quidz helps you unlock cosmetics faster.

Candy Hearts is a limited-time Valentine’s event currency. It is used for special event skins such as Cupid Bart and Valentine’s Lisa. Since this currency is event-based, any code that gives Candy Hearts may expire once the Valentine’s event ends. It is smart to redeem it as soon as possible.

For more free rewards, check out our updated BLR Legacy codes, Roblox Deep codes, and Solo Hunters codes lists for the latest working codes.

Expired You vs Homer Codes

FREEHEARTZ, SORRY, SORRYBUTAWESOME

How to Redeem You VS Homer Codes

Redeeming codes in You VS Homer takes less than a minute. Just follow these steps carefully.

  1. Launch You VS Homer on Roblox and wait until you load into the main lobby.
  2. Look at the bottom-left corner of the screen.
  3. Click the purple coupon or tag icon next to the camera button.
  4. Enter one of the working codes exactly as shown above.
  5. Click the purple arrow or press Enter.

If the code is valid, you will see a confirmation message on screen. Your Quidz or Candy Hearts balance will update instantly.

You VS Homer Code Not Working? Troubleshooting Guide

If your code is not working, the problem is usually small and easy to fix. Check the points below before assuming the code has expired.

  • Typing mistake: Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code. Even one incorrect letter will trigger an error. The safest method is to copy and paste the code exactly as shown.
  • Already redeemed: Roblox codes can only be used once per account. If you have claimed it before, it will not work again.
  • Recent update: If the game just received an update, the servers may need a short moment to refresh. Wait a minute and try again.
  • Event-based expiry: Some codes are tied to limited-time events. Candy Hearts, for example, are part of the Valentine’s event. Once the event ends, related codes may stop working without notice.

If none of the above fixes the issue, the code has most likely expired.

What Is You VS Homer?

You VS Homer is an asymmetrical hide-and-seek horror game on Roblox. At the start of each round, players are randomly assigned a role.

Most players spawn as Bart. As Bart, your goal is simple but stressful. You have 30 seconds to find a hiding spot before Homer spawns. You can hide in dumpsters, climb buildings, squeeze into tight corners, or keep moving. If you survive for 175 seconds, the Barts win.

One or more players become Homer. As Homer, your job is to hunt down every Bart before time runs out. You move fast, you check common hiding spots, and you listen for movement or taunts. If you catch every Bart before the timer ends, Homer wins.

The game mixes retro Roblox chaos with Simpsons-inspired humor. It feels silly at first, but when the timer is low and footsteps get closer, it becomes intense very quickly.

What Can You Buy With Quidz and Candy Hearts?

Currency in You VS Homer is purely cosmetic. It will not make you run faster or survive longer. But it does let you stand out.

With Quidz, you can buy various Bart and Homer skins from the shop. Some are simple variants, while others are more creative and themed.

With Candy Hearts, you can unlock limited-time Valentine’s skins. These are seasonal, which means they may not return once the event ends. If you care about collecting rare cosmetics, redeeming FREEHEARTZ is important.

How to Get More You VS Homer Codes

New codes usually appear during updates, special events, or milestones.

Developers often share codes through their official X account and the HOMER FANCLUB Discord server. However, codes may be posted without notifications, which makes them easy to miss.

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update it whenever new codes are released, so you do not miss free rewards. Codes do not last forever, and early redemption is always safer.

Final Thoughts

That’s all for our Roblox You VS Homer Codes list. We’ll keep checking for new codes and update this page whenever fresh rewards are released. Since Roblox codes can expire without warning, make sure to redeem them as soon as possible. If any code is not working, try restarting the game and entering it again exactly as shown.

  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Jujutsu Legacy Codes
  • Mojave Valley Codes
  • Roblox Knockout Codes

  • HUNDREDFLAMES: 8 Flame Souls, 8 Flame Quartzs, and 5 Sun Fragments (NEW)
  • UPDATE12: 2 Legendary Scrolls (NEW)
  • LUCKYSPIN: Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • SORRYFORSHUTDOWN: 25 Cinder Marks and 40 Soul Embers (NEW)

These rewards mostly include Gems, which are used to unlock and upgrade abilities. Some codes may grant Stat Resets or Class Rerolls depending on the update.

For more free rewards, check out our updated My Dragon Island codes, Fruit Battlegrounds codes, and Hunty Zombie codes lists for the latest working codes and in-game bonuses.

What Do Solo Hunters Codes Give?

Most codes reward one of the following:

  • Gems – The main in-game currency used for unlocking and improving abilities.
  • Class Rerolls – Let’s you change your class if you are unhappy with your current one.
  • Stat Resets – Resets your allocated stats so you can rebuild your character properly.

If you are new, save rerolls until you understand how classes perform in higher-tier dungeons. Stat resets are best used when you want to completely change your build.

How to Redeem Codes in Solo Hunters

The redemption system differs slightly from that in most Roblox games. You cannot enter codes from a menu. You must visit a specific NPC in the Overworld.

Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Launch Solo Hunters in Roblox.
  2. Complete the opening tutorial until you unlock the Overworld.
  3. Press Start Dungeon if needed and wake up in the Overworld area.
  4. Press M on PC to open the map.
  5. Head all the way south toward the dock area.
  6. Look for the blue NPC wearing a red hat near the crane.
  7. Approach the NPC and press E to interact.
  8. Enter a working code in the text box.
  9. Click Redeem.

On mobile, the map shortcut may not be available. Simply walk south from spawn until you reach the docks.

Why Is My Solo Hunter’s code not working?

If a code fails, it is usually for one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed it incorrectly.
  • You copied an extra space before or after the code.
  • The game servers have just been updated and will take a minute to refresh.

Codes are sometimes case-sensitive in Roblox games, so the safest option is to copy and paste directly. Each code can only be redeemed once per account.

Browse our complete list of Roblox codes to unlock free rewards.

How Often Are New Codes Released?

New codes usually appear:

  • After major updates
  • During bug fixes
  • When the game hits milestones
  • During seasonal events

Developers typically share code in their official Discord server, mostly inside the announcements channel. Since they do not always tag players, many people miss them. That is why keeping this page bookmarked saves time. We update this page as soon as new codes drop. 

What Is Solo Hunters?

Solo Hunters is a dungeon-crawling Roblox RPG inspired by Solo Leveling. You start as a weak hunter and gradually grow stronger by clearing dungeons, defeating bosses, collecting loot, and upgrading abilities. Each dungeon has multiple rooms, tougher enemies, and a final boss that tests your build.

Your stats directly impact performance. Strength, Defense, Health, Attack Speed, and Critical Chance all shape your playstyle. A poorly planned build can slow your progress. A smart build can make even higher-tier dungeons manageable.

Codes help bridge that gap. They give you flexibility. They give you second chances. And in a game where scaling matters, that flexibility is powerful.

Final Thoughts

Solo Hunters reward patience and smart build planning. Codes are not just free rewards. They are tools that help you refine your character and stay competitive as updates roll out.

Redeem active codes quickly, experiment carefully with rerolls, and use stat resets only when you understand your class direction. That is how you grow from a rookie hunter into one of the strongest players in the dungeon.

Update: Verified the latest Control Codes on August 03, 2026

Walking into Control feels familiar in the worst possible way. You have a badge, a flashlight, and that quiet dread that something is watching you from the dark corners of the facility. Inspired by Remedy’s Control, this Roblox horror experience puts you in the role of a C.T.R.L. employee whose job quickly turns into a fight for survival. And in a place where every mistake can be fatal, Control codes become your lifeline.

These codes give you free money and fragments, the two resources that decide whether you walk out prepared or panic-stricken. Below is a complete, up-to-date breakdown of every working Control code, what they give, how to redeem them, and where to find more when new updates drop.

All Working Control Codes

  • ROCKSTAR: 3000 Money and 30 Fragments (NEW)
  • 2KCOUNTING: 4000 Money and 35 Fragments (NEW)
  • SORRY4DELAY2: 5000 Money and 30 Fragments (NEW)
  • SORRY!: 5000 Money and 25 Fragments
  • MASTERY: 2000 Money and 25 Fragments
  • BIGUPDATE: 4000 Money and 40 Fragments
  • 1KGOAL!: 3000 Money and 20 Fragments
  • NEWCLASSES!: 4000 Money and 40 Fragments
  • VALENTINE!: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • BUGFIXES03: 2500 Money and 20 Fragments
  • CONTROL: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • BUGFIXES02: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • LOSTHOPE: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • 3KFOLLOWERS: 5000 Money and 25 Fragments
  • CHRISTMAS: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • FARMERUPD: 3500 Money and 25 Fragments
  • FIXES: 5000 Money
  • UPDATE01: 25 Fragments
  • BUGFIXES01: 2000 Money
  • RELEASE: 2000 Money

The developers regularly release codes alongside updates, bug fixes, milestones, and seasonal events. Each code rewards you with money, fragments, or both, helping you unlock cosmetics, upgrades, and progression essentials.

All codes above are verified and working as of 2026; redeem them as soon as possible before they expire.

Are There Any Expired Control Codes?

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

What Do Control Codes Actually Give You?

Control codes mainly reward money and fragments, both of which are essential for progression. Money is currently used to unlock skins and emotes, letting you customize your character and stand out in the facility. While cosmetics won’t save you from the horrors directly, feeling confident in your look can strangely make the fear easier to face.

Fragments are more valuable long-term. They act as key materials tied to upgrades and progression systems, making them crucial as the game evolves through updates.

How to Redeem Control Codes in Roblox

Redeeming codes in Control is quick and simple, even when your nerves are shot. Just follow these steps carefully:

  1. Open Control on Roblox.
  2. Click the Codes button on the left or bottom-left of the screen.
  3. Type or paste a working code into the text box.
  4. Press Claim to receive your rewards instantly.

Once redeemed, your money and fragments will immediately appear in your account.

Why Your Control Code Might Not Be Working

If a code doesn’t work, don’t panic. The issue is usually simple. A single typo, missing letter, or extra space can invalidate a code. Always copy and paste codes directly to avoid mistakes. Also, make sure your internet connection is stable and that you haven’t already redeemed the same code before.

If problems persist, restarting the Roblox client often fixes hidden glitches.

Where to Find More Control Codes

New Control codes usually drop during updates, bug fixes, and community milestones. To stay ahead:

  • Bookmark this page, we update the codes when we find new ones. 
  • Join the official Control Discord server and watch the #codes channel
  • Become a member of the Control Corporation Roblox group for news and possible exclusive rewards

You can also explore the Control Wiki for deep dives into entities, classes, items, and survival strategies if you want to be fully prepared.

Final Thoughts

Control isn’t just another Roblox horror game. It’s a slow-burning experience built on tension, isolation, and the fear of the unknown. Control codes soften that edge just enough to help you breathe, prepare, and push forward.

Redeem every code, gear up wisely, and remember—sometimes survival isn’t about being fearless, but about being prepared when the lights go out.

  • Roblox Horse Life Codes
  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes

Update: Verified the latest Waste Time Codes on August 02, 2026

There’s something oddly comforting about a game that doesn’t rush you, judge you, or demand your attention every second. Waste Time on Roblox leans fully into that feeling. It’s a game built around the quiet idea that doing nothing can still move you forward and somehow, that makes it deeply relatable.

In this guide, we’ll walk through Waste Time codes, what they are, why they matter, how to use them, and how they quietly shape your progress while you sit back and let time pass.

All Active Waste Time Codes

  • SorryForDelayII: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • ChapterIV: Free Rewards
  • ClansUPD: Free Rewards

Some sources list expiration dates for certain codes, while others still show them as active. To be safe, redeem codes as soon as possible. Idle games reward patience, but codes rarely do.

Expired Waste Time Codes

10MILLIONVISITSWOW, 20KCCU, ADMINPANEL, CALAMITYISAMAZING, CARDS, CENTRAL, CHAPTER3, CLANSAREFIXED, COMPENSATION, FREECLICKS, FREELOCKSFR, FREEREROLLSFR, GULLIBLE, HOLYMOLY, IMSORRYLOWK, IMSOSORRY, MORECLICKSFR, MORETREE, OBBY, PRADIZYASKINGFORNEWCODE, QOL, QUESTSHERE, QUICK, SORRY3, SORRYFORBROKENCLANS, SORRYFORDELAY2, SORRYFORNOTFIXINGCLANSYET, SORRYFORP2W, STPATRICKS, SUPERDUPERHIDDEN, VALENTINES, VALENTINES2, WEHAVECODESNOW, WOWOWOOWOWOWOWOWOOWOWOWO, YESANOTHERCODE, YETANOTHERCOMPENSATION

What Is Waste Time, Really?

At its core, Waste Time is an incremental simulator where existing in the game is the gameplay. You earn Time simply by staying in the world. That Time is then converted into Eons, which multiply how fast you earn even more Time. Over time, this loop opens up new areas, portals, and exponential growth.

It sounds simple and it is but that simplicity is exactly what makes the game special.

This is where Waste Time codes step in. They don’t change the spirit of the game. Instead, they gently smooth the edges, giving you small boosts that respect your time rather than replace it.

What Are Waste Time Codes and Why They Matter

Waste Time codes are free promotional rewards released by the developers, No time at all. These codes give you items that help fine-tune your progress instead of forcing you to grind harder.

Most codes reward one of four things:

  • Enchantment Rerolls, which let you roll for better bonuses
  • Enchantment Locks, which protect good bonuses from being overwritten
  • Highest Reset Stat multipliers, which massively boost long-term progress
  • Button Clicks, which speed up certain in-game actions

Individually, these rewards seem small. Together, they quietly reshape how fast and how far you can goespecially if you play passively or AFK.

How to Redeem Waste Time Codes

You can’t redeem codes immediately when you join the game, and that’s intentional. Waste Time wants you to experience its loop first. After playing for a short while and converting enough Time into Eons, the code system unlocks naturally.

  1. Launch Waste Time on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Scroll icon on the right side of your screen.
  3. Open it and select the Codes section.
  4. Enter or paste a working code.
  5. Press Redeem and enjoy the reward.

Codes are generally case-sensitive, so copying and pasting is the safest way to avoid mistakes.

Why a Code Might Not Work

If a code fails, it’s usually for one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired
  • The code was already redeemed on your account
  • There’s a spelling or capitalization error
  • The servers haven’t refreshed after a recent update

If a brand-new code doesn’t work right away, waiting a short while or rejoining the game often fixes the issue.

Other Free Boosts You Might Miss

Codes aren’t the only way to gain free advantages in Waste Time. The game quietly rewards social and passive play.

Playing with friends grants a percentage-based Time boost, which stacks depending on how many friends are in your server. You can also gain extra boosts by:

  • Liking the game
  • Following the developers
  • Joining the official Roblox group

These bonuses may seem small, but in an exponential system, even tiny boosts grow loud over time.

Unlocking New Areas and Why Eons Matter

Once you collect 100 Eons, which requires converting 100,000 Time, you unlock a new zone with three important portals:

  • The Library – Requires 10M Time and grants a 1.5× boost
  • The Future – Requires 1Sx Time and grants a 2× boost
  • The End – Requires 1Td Time and grants a 5× boost

Converting Time into Eons isn’t optionalit’s the heart of progression. Each Eon adds a +50% boost, and those boosts compound faster than most players expect.

Where to Find New Waste Time Codes

New codes are usually released during updates, milestones, or compensation events. The most reliable sources are:

  • The official Waste Time Discord server
  • Developer announcements from No time at all
  • Regularly updated code-tracking pages

Bookmark this page to stay updated without chasing announcements.

Final Thoughts: Why Waste Time Codes Feel Different

Most games use codes to push you forward faster. Waste Time uses them to make waiting feel better. That’s the quiet genius of it.

These codes don’t rush you. They sit in your inventory, patiently amplifying progress while you do what the game encourages mostnothing at all.

And in a world that’s always asking for more effort, that feels surprisingly refreshing.

In case you missed

  • Solo Hunters Codes
  • Roblox Control Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes
  • Anime Spike Codes
  • My Dragon Island Codes

Update: Verified the latest Anime Spike Codes on June 01, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes inside Anime Spike, you already know the feeling. Waves of anime-inspired enemies keep coming, progress feels slow at the start, and every upgrade matters. That is exactly where Anime Spike codes step in. These codes are not just bonuses; they are the game’s way of giving players a fair push forward without spending Robux.

Whether you are a new player trying to survive the early grind or a regular player looking to optimize your loadout, this guide walks you through everything you need to know. From the latest working codes to how to redeem them and why they sometimes fail, consider this your complete and reliable companion.

All Working Anime Spike Codes

  • UPDATE4: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions (NEW)
  • update2: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs3: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs2: x99 Spikes, x3 Coins Potions, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • srrybugs: x3 Coins Potins, x3 Damage Potions, x3 Energy Potions, and x3 Lucky Potions
  • SrryDelay: x1 Coins Potin, x1 Damage Potion, x1 Energy Potion, and x1 Lucky Potion
  • bugsfixed: x1 Coins Potin, x1 Damage Potion, x1 Energy Potion, and x1 Lucky Potion
  • SrryShut: x1 Coins Potin, x1 Damage Potion, x1 Energy Potion, and x1 Lucky Potion
  • srryshut2: x2 Coins Potins, x2 Damage Potions, x2 Energy Potions, and x2 Lucky Potions
  • Release: 1x Energy Potion

The developers regularly release codes to apologize for bugs, delays, or server shutdowns, and each one brings valuable rewards like potions and spikes. These items directly affect your damage, energy, luck, and coin gains, making progression much smoother.

Each potion provides a temporary boost that can dramatically change how fast you clear enemies. When used smartly, especially during tough waves or early progression, these rewards can save hours of grinding.

Are There Any Expired Anime Spike Codes?

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Anime Spike Codes

Redeeming codes in Anime Spike is quick and beginner-friendly. You do not need to reach a certain level or complete any missions beforehand.

Follow these steps carefully to claim your rewards:

  1. Launch Anime Spike on Roblox.
  2. Look to the left side of the screen and click the Shop (shopping cart) icon.
  3. Scroll down until you find the code input box.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Click the Redeem button.

Once redeemed successfully, your rewards are added instantly, ready to be used whenever you need them.

What Are Spikes and Potions Used For?

Understanding the rewards helps you use them wisely instead of wasting them early.

Spikes are a special in-game currency. They allow you to purchase exclusive items without spending Robux, making them extremely valuable for free-to-play players.

Potions provide temporary buffs that improve key stats like damage output, energy regeneration, coin earnings, and luck. These boosts are especially powerful when facing tougher enemies or pushing into new areas.

There are also rocks, which can be used for special gacha systems like Biju pulls, offering power boosts ranging from common to legendary.

Why Are My Anime Spike Codes Not Working?

If a code fails, it is usually for a simple reason. Here are the most common issues players face:

  • The code was typed incorrectly (codes are case-sensitive).
  • The code has already been redeemed on your account.
  • The code expired without notice.
  • Temporary server or internet connection issues.

To avoid problems, copy and paste codes directly and rejoin a fresh server if redemption fails the first time.

How to Get More Anime Spike Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page and check back often. Developers usually release new code during updates, bug fixes, or unexpected shutdowns.

You can also keep an eye on:

  • The official Anime Spike Discord server (when available)
  • The ?¿ Company Roblox group for announcements and updates

New codes often drop quietly, so staying connected gives you an advantage.

Final Thoughts

Anime Spike is built around steady progression, and codes are a core part of that design. They reward patience, soften the grind, and make the game more enjoyable, especially for players who prefer not to spend Robux.

If you use these codes wisely and keep an eye out for new ones, you will find yourself clearing waves faster, upgrading smarter, and enjoying the game for what it truly is: a fast-paced, anime-inspired experience that respects your time.
